title: Marketing & Operations Assistant
description:
We're Hiring: Marketing & Operations Assistant

Location: 100% remote (based in Philippines)

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



At JazzUpCo, growth comes from turning great ideas into great execution. As we continue to scale across multiple channels - from Shopify and Amazon to retail and wholesale - strong operations become increasingly important.



We’re looking for a Marketing & Operations Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will split your time between driving our Amazon channel expansion and keeping the supply chain humming through weekly inventory checks and fulfilment routines.

_________________________________________________



Role Overview



First 3–6 Months Focus

- 75% Marketing Support: Drive execution across Amazon listing management, launch prep, basic PPC, and marketing systems.

- 25% Operations Support: Assist with inventory monitoring, routine warehouse tasks, and stock health tracking.



Long-Term Focus (6th Month onwards)

-50% Marketing / 50% Operations: Shift into a balanced role managing ongoing marketing projects, collaborator inquiries, and routine supply chain support.



Amazon Management & Support

- Set up and optimize Amazon listings, including product titles, bullet points, backend keywords, image uploads, and A+ Content.



- Handle end-to-end FBA routines, creation of shipping plans, inventory tracking, and catalog troubleshooting inside Seller Central.



- Assist with Amazon PPC campaigns by monitoring keyword performance, ad metrics, and routine ad maintenance.

Marketing Operations & Assistant Support



- Serve as the system keeper—ensuring team processes are actively used and marketing deliverables are followed through on time.



- Manage inbound collaboration inquiries, handle creator communications, and execute basic website updates.



Operations & Supply Chain Support

- Conduct weekly inventory health checks to proactively flag out-of-stock (OOS) and overstock risks.



- Conduct inventory planning and inventory fulfilment forecasting to keep stock aligned with demand.



- Support routine warehouse operations, including order splits, clearing warehouse stock, and routine fulfillment tasks.

_________________________________________________



You’re a Fit If You Have:



- Experience in building listings, uploading assets, setting up A+ Content, and managing FBA routines.



- Comfortable providing ad support by tracking keywords, impressions, and basic campaign performance metrics.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- Comfortable with spreadsheets, order splits, warehouse clearing, and tracking overstock or out-of-stock risks.



- Friendly and professional when managing incoming creator collaborations and basic website updates.



- Detail-oriented mindset that spots typos in listings or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between creative marketing tasks and practical operations support.

_________________________________________________



Why Join JazzUpCo?



- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants while sharpening your strategic project management skills and growing into a senior operations leader.



-Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________



Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:



1) Apply: Via the application form -
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview: Get to know each other

3) Trial Task: Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team: Onboarding + probation --> full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Marketing & Admin VA for an iPhone app — outreach, research, reporting
description:
ABOUT



I run a small software studio (ExoLabs Studio Limited). We just launched

Traak, an iPhone app that tracks all your online orders in one place —

SHEIN, Temu, Amazon — and tells you when a package is out for delivery.

It's live on the App Store. I'm the only person on the team, which is

why I'm hiring.



I'm looking for one person to take over the repeating work around the

app so I can stay on the product. The tasks vary, but they're all the

same kind of work: careful, repeatable, done without being chased.



WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE



Most of your time goes to finding creators and contacting them. You'll

search TikTok, Instagram and YouTube for people who post haul and

unboxing videos — the kind who order from SHEIN, Temu or Amazon and film

what arrives. You look for mid-sized accounts, mostly in the US, UK and

Canada, check their bio for a business
, keep everything organised

in a shared Google Sheet, and send them a collaboration
. The

is already written — you're sending it, not writing it. When someone

replies, it comes to me. You never negotiate money.



The rest of the week changes. Some of it is reading our support inbox

and answering simple questions from replies I've prepared, and passing

real bugs to me with a clear description of what the user did. Some of

it is watching new App Store reviews. Some weeks it's copying figures

into a sheet so I can see the trend, or looking at what competing apps

charge and what their reviews complain about.



I'll train you on each of these one at a time. Nobody starts knowing all

of it.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



  - Clear written English. You'll write to American creators and to our

    users. Not perfect English — clear English.

  - Comfortable with Google Sheets and Gmail. Everything runs on those.

  - Careful. This is work where one careless send does real damage, so

    I'd much rather have a few
s done properly than a lot done fast.

  - Able to work without being chased. I won't be checking on you daily.

  - Honest about what you did, including on the slow days.



WHAT YOU DON'T NEED



  - No marketing degree. No copywriting, design, or video editing.

  - No experience with apps or software.

  - No paid tools — everything is free.



HOURS AND PAY



  - 20 hours per week. You choose your schedule inside the week; I don't

    watch a timer.

  - $350 to $500 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice a

    month by Wise or PayPal.

  - Starts with one paid trial week at the same rate, on real work, so

    we both find out if it fits before committing.

  - Long term if it works, with more hours later if you want them. This

    is not a one-off project.



If this sounds like your kind of work, tell me a little about yourself

and what you've done before.

title: Video Editor
description:
AI VIDEO EDITOR - KLING & NANO BANANA PRO



We are looking for a detail-oriented and creative AI Video Editor to join our team full-time.



Your main responsibility will be turning written creative briefs into polished short-form video advertisements.



You will review a brief, generate the required base images using Nano Banana Pro, animate those images using Kling, and prepare the final video for delivery.



We will provide training on our specific systems and creative process. However, previous hands-on experience with both Kling and Nano Banana Pro is required.



This role is best suited to someone who follows instructions carefully, notices small visual details, and has a strong eye for design.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Read and understand detailed video briefs.

- Generate high-quality base images using Nano Banana Pro.

- Turn generated images into realistic video clips using Kling.

- Follow visual references closely, including character appearance, framing, setting, movement, and overall style.

- Write and adjust AI-generation prompts when necessary.

- Review generated images and clips carefully before submitting them.

- Regenerate assets when the result does not match the brief.

- Combine clips and complete basic video editing when required.

- Add subtitles, text overlays, audio, or other simple editing elements when included in the brief.

- Organize project files and export videos using the correct names, formats, and dimensions.

- Make revisions based on feedback from the creative team.

- Complete assigned videos within the agreed deadlines.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Previous hands-on experience using Kling.

- Previous hands-on experience using Nano Banana Pro.

- Strong attention to detail.

- A good eye for design, composition, framing, and visual consistency.

- Able to follow detailed written and visual instructions closely.

- Able to compare your work against a reference and notice what needs to be corrected.

- Comfortable generating multiple versions until the result is right.

- Able to understand feedback and apply it accurately.

- Strong organization and file-management skills.

- Reliable communication during working hours.

- Able to manage deadlines and complete tasks without repeated reminders.

- Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for video-editing work.



Experience creating short-form advertisements, social media videos, UGC-style content, or e-commerce creatives is highly preferred.



Experience with CapCut, or similar video-editing software is also helpful.



IMPORTANT



We can train you on our internal workflow, naming systems, briefs, and creative standards.



However, this is not a beginner position for someone who has never used AI image or video-generation tools before. You must already have practical experience with both Kling and Nano Banana Pro.



We care more about the quality of your work and your ability to follow instructions than formal qualifications.



THIS ROLE WILL NOT SUIT SOMEONE WHO



- Has never used Kling or Nano Banana Pro.

- Skims instructions instead of reading the full brief.

- Submits the first generated result without checking its quality.

- Regularly misses small but important details.

- Struggles to match references closely.

- Becomes careless when completing repetitive revisions.

- Needs to be reminded repeatedly about deadlines.

- Disappears or becomes unresponsive during working hours.

- Is unwilling to regenerate a clip when the result is not good enough.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After the first few months:



- You can understand our creative briefs with minimal explanation.

- Your generated characters, scenes, and video clips closely match the provided references.

- You catch visual mistakes before submitting your work.

- Videos are delivered on time and exported correctly.

- Feedback is understood and applied without the same mistakes being repeated.

- You become faster while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- The creative team can trust you to take a brief and turn it into a finished video.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



- Full-time, long-term remote position.

- Working schedule: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine Time.

- Salary: $500 to $1,000 USD per month, depending on experience and ability.

- Salary and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance.

- This is intended to become a stable, long-term role for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, complete the Google Form below:







Please do not apply through a generic message only. Applicants must complete the Google Form to be considered.

title: Editor
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for skilled editors who can generate an article from our brief using AI and then edit it into something a real reader would finish and a client would be proud to publish. You are not a writer and you will not be starting from a blank page. 

You own the piece from generation through to the version that goes to the client. You will work across client industries, currently weighted towards healthcare, with expansion into finance and other verticals.



This is not proofreading. Grammar and spelling are the floor, not the job. The hard part is the human factor. AI will hand you something fluent, confident and completely generic, and your job is to turn that into something that reads like a person who knows the subject wrote it. The finished article has to answer what the reader actually searched for, say something the first three Google results do not, and carry none of the tells that make a reader stop trusting the page.



Engagement Terms

- Tasks are posted in a WhatsApp group on a first come, first served basis, the same group you are added to once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star editor and cleared the test. The first person to claim a task owns it. If it is not delivered by the stated deadline, it goes back to the group.

- There is no minimum volume, but consistent editors get first sight of the bigger jobs.

- You will be given the client's style guide, the SEO brief and the target keyword for each piece.



Key Responsibilities

Writing quality

- Generate the first draft from our brief, target keyword and the SERP competitors using AI. Prompt it with the brief, the competitor pages and the client's existing copy rather than a one-line instruction. The raw output is your starting point, never your deliverable.

- Strip the AI tells before anyone else sees it: uniform paragraph lengths, em dashes, empty openers, hedged claims, lists with nothing specific in them, and confident statements with no source behind them.

- Ensure the text is free from grammar, spelling and punctuation errors.

- Keep the language user-friendly and concise. Cut filler.

- Match the client's house voice, including US or UK spelling as instructed per client.



Reader experience

- Logical: establish authority and credibility using supporting evidence such as statistics, academic publications, case studies, testimonials, Google reviews and relevant endorsements.

 Emotional: create a sense of assurance and connection. Use the PEEL structure (Point, Elaboration, Example, Link) and keep it authentic and relatable.

- Highlight and sharpen the client's unique selling points so the piece does not read like every competitor's page.



SEO checks

- Confirm the draft answers the search intent behind the target keyword. If the ranking pages are comparisons and our draft is a sales page, flag it.

- Target keyword present in the H1, the first 100 words, the meta title and two or three H2s, placed naturally and never stuffed.

- Meta title and meta description within length, keyword front-loaded, appearing once, no filler calls to action.

- Correct heading hierarchy with no skipped levels.

- Internal links to the relevant service pages, with descriptive anchor text.

- Flag missing or unsourced claims and any section that is too thin to stand.



Business and compliance

- Place calls to action strategically, for example after treatments, after benefits, and after the "why choose us" section, rather than one block at the end.

- For healthcare clients, ensure the copy complies with the Healthcare Services (Advertisement) Regulations. Flag superlatives, guarantees, comparative claims and testimonials that cannot stand.



Preferred Skills

- Minimum 1 year of editing experience. Agency or content-marketing experience preferred.

- Working knowledge of SEO. Deep technical SEO is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Able to drive AI tools well (ChatGPT, Claude or similar), and more importantly able to tell when the output is generic and fix it.

- Comfortable working from a brief and a style guide without hand-holding.

- Excellent written English, native or near-native fluency.

- Able to switch between US and UK spelling on instruction.

- Bonus: healthcare or finance content experience.



How to Apply

- Please attach your CV and two published pieces you edited, and name one of them you are still proud of.

- Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the
 thread.

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team.

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

- Bonus: experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet working space, and a plan for power outages.

title: Senior AI Video Editor / E-commerce Creative Producer
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



This is not an entry-level position. 



Hi, I’m Kay. I’m looking for a full-time Senior AI Video Editor / Creative Producer to join my e-commerce business.



You will create short-form product ads using AI-generated visuals and edit them into finished videos for testing.



We’re looking for someone with strong experience in video editing, AI video generation, and e-commerce or direct-response advertising. You should be creative, reliable, proactive, and able to take ownership of your work.



We are a small team, but we have been steadily expanding. You will help us improve our creative standards and production workflows and grow with the business long-term.



---



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Develop prompts and creative concepts based on proven advertising ideas.

- Generate original AI clips and images while maintaining visual consistency.

- Edit short-form direct-response ads with captions, music, sound effects, and simple visual effects.

- Create different hooks, scenes, and creative variations for testing.

- Improve your work based on feedback and advertising results.

- Manage projects, deadlines, and AI-generation costs efficiently.

- Help improve creative workflows and provide feedback on other creatives when needed.



---



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong experience in video editing and AI video generation.

- Experience with e-commerce, direct-response, or Meta video ads.

- Familiar with all types of AI video ad formats.

- Familiar with writing ad concepts, scripts and briefs.

- A strong portfolio of AI videos, short-form ads, or social media content.

- Good understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and CTAs.

- Good visual taste, creative judgment, and attention to detail.

- Able to work independently, solve problems, and meet deadlines consistently.

- Good communication skills.

- Reliable, organized, proactive, and interested in long-term growth.



---

TOOLS YOU MIGHT USE



- Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, etc.

- CapCut, Final Cut Pro, etc.

- ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.

- Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, etc.



---

OTHER INFORMATION



- Daytime Philippines working hours.

- Performance bonuses and future growth opportunities are available.

- Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial task.

- This is a stable, long-term position.



---

TO APPLY



Please send:

- Your resume.

- Your portfolio with past examples.

- The editing and AI tools you have used.

- Laptop specifications and internet-speed screenshot.

- Use the subject line: [Senior Creative Producer – Your Full Name]

- Please also send a short Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube video answering (optional but highly preferred):

1. Your experience with AI video, editing and direct response marketing.

2. Tell me about your most recent role. What were your main responsibilities, and what level of ownership did you have?

3. What is your current employment situation, and why did you leave your last position?

4. Your availability and desired salary.

5. Why are you interested in this role?

6. Where do you see yourself in 5 years?

(I know everyone’s time is precious, but a recording helps me get to know you better as a person!)

About Us

We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the health supplement space, scaling a subscription-first business with a loyal customer base. We move fast, we take care of our customers like family, and we hold ourselves to a high standard in everything we do.

We're looking for a Customer Support Specialist who doesn't just close tickets, but genuinely cares about customers, thinks about retention, and wants to grow into a leadership role.



The Role

We're hiring a full-time, remote Customer Support Specialist to be the front line of our brand. This is a long-term role and you'll be working directly with the Founder, with a clear path to becoming our CS Manager as the team grows.



What You'll Do



- Handle customer inquiries via
 and chat (order issues, subscription changes, refunds, product questions)

- Manage and resolve tickets efficiently inside Commslayer

- Protect and grow MRR by retaining subscribers, offering pauses, swaps, or win-backs before cancellations go through

- Monitor subscription health and flag churn risks proactively

- Maintain response time and CSAT targets weekly

- Identify recurring issues and escalate patterns to the Founder

- Represent the brand with warmth, clarity, and professionalism in every interaction



You Need



- Hands-on experience with Commslayer (non-negotiable)

- Experience supporting a subscription-based brand: you understand MRR, churn, and why retention matters

- Familiarity with Shopify (order management, refunds, subscription apps)

- Strong written English: clear, warm, and professional

- High attention to detail and ability to manage ticket volume without dropping the ball

- A customer-first mindset with the initiative to solve problems, not just respond to them

- Hunger to grow: we want someone who wants to eventually lead a team



What You'll Get



Base salary

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Direct contact with the Founder

- First in line to become CS Manager as the brand scales



How to Apply

title: Motion Graphics Designer – YouTube Documentaries

We produce documentary-style content for YouTube covering geopolitics, finance, alternative history, and current events. We're looking for a skilled motion graphics designer who can bring stories to life through compelling visuals, animations, and graphic sequences.

- Good eye for cinematic composition, color grading awareness, and typography

 how to visualize information

- Experience with map animations (troop movements, geopolitical borders, trade routes)

Send 2-3 *relevant* motion graphics samples you created.

Tell me your turnaround time for a typical 20-minute documentary and which tools you use daily.

If you read this, start your application with the word orange.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist — YouTube Creative Team
description:
THE ROLE



We run a fast-growing YouTube channel and we need someone who can find the best creative talent on the internet. Not average. Not available. The best.



Your job is to source, screen, and deliver top-tier candidates for three roles we hire repeatedly: video editors, motion graphics designers, and thumbnail designers with strong AI image generation skills.



Every person you bring us needs to understand one thing above everything else: what makes a YouTube video actually perform. Not what looks good in a portfolio. What drives views, watch time, and clicks.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build and maintain a constantly updated pipeline of pre-vetted candidates for all three roles

- Source talent across OnlineJobs.ph, LinkedIn, Reddit, 
 servers, and anywhere else skilled people hang out

- Screen applicants with custom tests and structured interviews you design yourself

- Evaluate video edit tests, motion reel submissions, and thumbnail samples with a real eye for quality

- Assess whether candidates understand YouTube metrics, not just aesthetics

- Manage the full hiring process from first contact to offer, with fast turnaround

- Keep detailed candidate notes and a running shortlist ready to go at any time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You have hired for YouTube creative roles before, or you have worked in a YouTube production environment yourself

- You can tell the difference between a good editor and a great one by watching a 90-second reel

- You understand what a high-CTR thumbnail looks like and why it works

- You know what motion graphics are actually supposed to do on screen and when they earn their place

- You are familiar with AI image generation tools like Midjourney, Ideogram, or Flux and can assess how well a designer uses them

- You move fast, communicate clearly, and follow through without needing to be managed

- You are honest about candidate quality even when the pipeline is thin



This is not an entry-level HR role. We are not looking for someone who posts jobs and waits. We want a hunter who is opinionated about creative quality and has high standards.



NICE TO HAVE



- You have a personal YouTube channel or have worked closely with content creators

- You have existing networks in the YouTube editing or design freelance community

- You have used hiring tools like Notion, Airtable, or similar to manage candidate pipelines

- You have worked with remote, async teams before



DETAILS



- Full-time, remote

- Async-first, results-based

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Long-term role with direct access to the business owner



HOW TO APPLY



Send us a short voice or video message (2 to 3 minutes) telling us about a specific hire you made for a creative role and how you evaluated the candidate's work. If you have never hired for YouTube or content creation specifically, explain how you would approach evaluating a video editor's test submission.



Applications without this message will not be considered. We do not need a cover letter. We need to hear how you think.

title: TikTok Shop Operations Specialist - Backend & Seller Center (Remote)
description:
We are hiring a TikTok Shop Operations Specialist for our client, a TikTok-native agency that manages TikTok Shop growth for global brands including Gymshark, Duolingo, Shopify, Amazon, Converse, Notion, and Victoria's Secret. Our client manages $250M+ in ad spend per year and works with 100+ active clients.



This is a backend operations role. You will be the person who makes Seller Center work - setting up shops, managing product listings, handling compliance, and keeping every shop running smoothly while the activation team focuses on growth.

This is NOT a strategy, creative, or content role. It is hands-on, detail-heavy, and operational.



What You Will Do:



- Full TikTok Shop setup from A to Z: brand verification, product verification, shipping, tax, returns, and catalogue structure

- Create, upload, and optimise product listings. Fix listing errors and resolve suppressions

- Enrol products into TikTok campaigns (flash deals, seasonal promotions, vouchers) and troubleshoot eligibility issues

- Monitor Seller Performance Score, identify compliance risks, submit appeals, and manage resolution

- Troubleshoot backend issues: listing errors, payment and payout problems, shipping discrepancies

- Support TikTok Shop affiliate programmes - product mapping, commission setup, and performance tracking

- Work closely with the Activation Lead, Affiliate Team, and Client Success Managers

- Deliver clear daily and weekly reports on shop status, listings, and campaign participation



Must-Have Requirements:



- 1–2+ years of hands-on TikTok Shop experience, including full shop setups from scratch

- Direct experience with brand and product verification processes and compliance appeals

- Strong troubleshooting skills inside Seller Center - you know where to look and how to fix it

- Experience supporting TikTok Shop affiliate programmes (product mapping, commission setup)

- Excellent attention to detail - nothing slips through

- Proficient in Google Sheets / Excel

- Comfortable using project management tools (ClickUp or similar)

- Strong written English

- Comfortable managing multiple brands and shifting priorities at the same time



Nice to Have:



-Previous agency experience

- Familiarity with TikTok Shop in multiple regions (UK, US, EU, SEA)



You Will Thrive Here If:



- You think in systems and enjoy keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes

- You catch errors and inconsistencies before anyone else does

- You work independently - give you the task and deadline, and it gets done

- You enjoy figuring out the root cause when something breaks

You want to deepen your expertise in TikTok commerce



This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You prefer strategy or creative work over execution

- You need detailed instructions for every task

- You find repetitive backend work tedious

- You want a client-facing role

title: Performance AI Video Editor (Meta Ads) - DTC eCommerce - Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand in the pet supplements space. We sell through paid social and are scaling our ad creative output. We are looking for one full-time performance video editor to own our Meta ad creative.



This is not a wedding/YouTube/corporate editing role. This is direct-response ad editing: UGC-style ads, hooks, captions, fast iteration, and editing with conversion as the only goal.



What You'll Do

As a Video Editor, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and inspiring videos for various channels such as Instagram and

Responsibilities:

• Edit raw footage into professional videos for social media, ads, tutorials, and brand stories.

• Adapt content for specific platform requirements (aspect ratio, length, etc.).



What We're Looking For:

• Experience in video editing and post-production (minimum 2 years of experience).

• Proficiency with video editing software (e.g., Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, etc.).

• Creative and passionate about visual storytelling.

• Experience in the pet industry is a plus but not required.



What We Offer:

• A dynamic and inspiring work environment within a fast-growing brand.

title: AI CREATIVE PRODUCER (META ADS) — Images + Ad Copy
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC beauty brand. We grow through one channel above all: Meta ads. We're small, we move fast, and we ship every day. Your work will be running as live ads within 24 hours of making it.



Right now the founder creates every ad image and writes every ad copy himself. That's the bottleneck. You'll take it over.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Create the ad images: one batch per day: 5 concepts with 5 variations each, so 25 finished images. About 45 minutes per batch once you're trained.

2. Write the ad copy: primary text, headline and description for each ad, organized in our template.

3. Hand it off: everything into ClickUp, marked ready for our media buyer to launch.



You do NOT need to be a Photoshop wizard. We have a complete AI design system built on Claude, and we'll teach it to you in about an hour. What we can't teach is taste, speed, and caring about the work.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience creating images with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT/GPT Image, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, or similar)

- A design eye: you can tell a premium ad from a cheap one

- Clear, natural English writing 
 ad copy experience is a big plus)

- Extremely organized and reliable: when you say a batch is ready, it's ready

- You want to grow with us. This starts part-time and becomes full-time at a higher rate as we scale. We promote from inside.



Nice to have: Meta Ads Manager experience, beauty/skincare background.



We want someone trained and producing next week.



HOW TO APPLY



Most applications we get are copy-paste templates. Those get deleted unread. If you actually want this job:



Use this exact subject line: DAILY BATCH — [Your Name]



Then answer these 3 questions. Short and specific beats long and generic:



1. How many finished images will you produce per day in this role? (answer is in the job description)

2. Which AI tools have you used to create images, and what's one thing you've learned about getting good results from them? (Attach 2–3 examples.)

3. In your own words: what makes someone stop scrolling and read a
 ad?



Finally, attach your CV and tell us your available hours (Philippine time) and earliest start date.



Applications without the correct subject line will not be read. Everyone who follows these instructions gets a reply.

title: Finance Manager (Part Time, Remote) for UK Commercial Refrigeration Company
description:
The role:

This is a retained part time position: 4 days per month to begin with, structured as one day a week or two blocks of two days, your choice. As the business grows the days grow with it, and the right person becomes our Head of Finance. We would rather pay a brilliant person for 4 days than an average one for 20.



What you will own each month

Weekly bank reconciliation: QuickBooks Online against Starling and Stripe. Nothing unallocated.



Month end: aged debtors against each customer's real terms, customer statements, engineer profit share verification, supplier invoices checked against orders.



Monthly management pack: P&L, cash, revenue by customer, gross margin by job type, overdue debtors, and a plain English note on what changed and what I should do about it.



The receivables system: you own the process and the tracker; our operations VA sends routine reminders under your rules. You step in on anything over 14 days overdue or disputed.



Controls: you catch duplicate invoices, VAT errors, parts paid twice, engineers paid on unpaid jobs, before they cost us money.

Improvement: every month the process should be a little better than the one you inherited.

description:
Land Analyst – U.S. Land Acquisition

Remote | Full-Time | Independent Contractor

Compensation: US$1,500/month



About Principal Acres

Principal Acres is a U.S.-based land acquisition company that specializes in acquiring vacant land across the United States.

We are looking for a Land Analyst to join our acquisitions team and help us research, analyze, and evaluate potential land acquisition opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys research, property data, numbers, problem-solving, and finding the details that matter.



What You'll Do:

• Research vacant land properties across the United States.

• Analyze county records, assessor information, tax records, parcel/APN information, and other property data.

• Research recent land sales and comparable properties to help determine market value.

• Review acreage, location, access, zoning, utilities, structures, and other relevant property characteristics.

• Research property ownership and verify seller/property information.

• Conduct preliminary due diligence on potential acquisitions.

• Identify property risks, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential red flags.

• Analyze whether properties meet Principal Acres' acquisition criteria.

• Prepare clear property analysis reports and acquisition summaries.

• Maintain accurate property information in the CRM and other Company systems.

• Work closely with the Acquisition Manager to support acquisition decisions.

• Prioritize properties that appear to have strong acquisition potential.



What We're Looking For:

• Excellent English - written and verbal.

• Strong analytical and research skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

• Comfortable working with large amounts of data.

• Comfortable learning CRM systems and online property research platforms.

• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving ability.

• Able to work independently and manage assigned research.

• Highly organized and disciplined.

• Self-motivated and reliable.



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:

• U.S. real estate

• Land acquisition

• Property research

• Real estate investing

• Due diligence

• Property valuation

• GIS / mapping

• U.S. county records

• Assessor or recorder websites

• Comparable-sales research



U.S. land experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right analytical candidate who demonstrates strong research ability and attention to detail.



The Type of Person We're Looking For:

We're not looking for someone who simply collects information.

We want someone who can look at the information, identify what matters, spot potential problems, and explain what the data means.

You should naturally be asking:

"Is this actually a property we should pursue?"

You should enjoy digging into information until you understand the property and can give the acquisitions team a clear, well-supported answer.



Success in this role will be measured by:

• Accuracy of property research

• Quality of comparable-sales analysis

• Number of properties successfully analyzed

• Turnaround time on assigned research

• Identification of property risks and red flags

• Accuracy of CRM and property records

• Quality of acquisition summaries

• Ability to identify and prioritize promising opportunities

• Reliability and consistency



Compensation & Working Arrangement

US$1,500 per month

• Full-time remote position

• Independent contractor

• Work with a U.S.-based land acquisition company

• Company-provided systems and tools

• Long-term opportunity for the right person



Important:

This is a research and analysis role, not a sales position.

You will be expected to work independently, pay close attention to detail, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly with the acquisitions team.

If you love research, real estate, data, and solving problems, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Part-Time Virtual Assistant – UK Plumbing Business & General Admin



We are a busy, established plumbing and heating business based in London, UK, looking for a reliable and proactive Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines.



This is initially a part-time role of approximately 10 hours per week, with flexible working hours and the potential for the role and hours to increase over time.



The role



The majority of your time will be supporting our plumbing and heating business with day-to-day administration.



Typical tasks will include:



Managing and organising
s

Following up customers, suppliers and contractors

Helping prepare and send quotations

Chasing outstanding information and paperwork

Organising files and documents

Updating spreadsheets

Supplier and product research

Obtaining prices and comparing options

Booking appointments and helping organise diaries

Helping with tenders and general business administration

Drafting professional
s and messages

Keeping track of outstanding tasks and following them through to completion

General problem-solving and research



There will also occasionally be administration relating to property investments and some personal/life administration such as travel bookings, research, appointments and purchases.



How we would work together



The role will be fairly flexible and is well suited to someone comfortable working independently.



A lot of our communication will be through WhatsApp, including voice notes.



I may send messages and tasks throughout the day as things arise. There is no expectation for you to respond immediately or constantly monitor WhatsApp.



Instead, you would pick up the outstanding tasks during your working hours, organise them, action what you can and keep me updated on progress.



We would ideally have a catch-up once per week where our working hours overlap, but there is no requirement to work normal UK office hours.



I am also happy to accommodate the Philippines/UK time difference when we need to speak.



The person we are looking for



The most important quality is initiative.



We do not want someone who simply waits for an instruction for every step.



We are looking for someone who can be given a task such as:



“Can you sort this out for me?”



…and then investigate it, work out the sensible next steps, take appropriate action and come back with an answer, recommendation or a small number of options.



You should have:



Excellent written and spoken English

Very good attention to detail

Strong organisation skills

Confidence using
, spreadsheets and online systems

Good internet research skills

Ability to communicate professionally with UK customers and businesses

Ability to prioritise several small tasks

Confidence asking questions when something genuinely isn't clear

Good common sense and problem-solving skills

Previous Virtual Assistant or business administration experience



Previous experience working with a UK business would be helpful but is not essential.



Experience in plumbing, construction or property is useful but not required.



Equipment



You must already have your own suitable setup for remote work, including:



Reliable computer or laptop

Smartphone

Stable internet connection

Suitable microphone/headset for calls

Ability to use WhatsApp comfortably

Ideally a backup internet option such as mobile data/hotspot



We are not looking for someone who needs equipment purchased for them in order to start the role.



Hours



Approximately 10 hours per week initially.



The hours do not need to be rigidly fixed at 2 hours every day.



We are happy for the right person to manage their time reasonably flexibly across the working week, provided tasks are dealt with reliably and communication is good.



There is potential for the hours to increase if the arrangement works well and there is enough ongoing work.



Pay



Starting pay: $4–$6 USD per hour depending on experience and ability.



A higher rate may be considered for an exceptional candidate.



We are looking for somebody long-term rather than simply looking for the cheapest VA available.



There will be an opportunity for increased hours, pay and responsibility for the right person.



How to apply



Please start your application with the words:



GREEN TAP



This lets us know you have read the full advert.



Please then answer the following:



Tell me briefly about your current or most recent VA/admin role.

Have you previously worked for a UK, Australian, US or European business? If yes, what did you do?

Would approximately 10 hours per week work for you?

What hourly rate are you looking for?

Do you currently work for any other clients? If so, approximately how many hours per week?

What computer/laptop and smartphone do you currently use for remote work?

What is your internet setup and do you have a backup connection?

Give an example of a situation where you were given a vague task or problem and worked out how to solve it yourself.



Finally, please complete this short exercise:



Imagine I send you the following WhatsApp voice note:



“We need a replacement kitchen tap for a customer. Find me three decent options available in the UK around £80–£150. It needs to be a good brand, chrome, suitable for a standard kitchen sink and ideally available quickly. Send me your recommendation.”



Tell me briefly how you would approach the task and how you would present the answer back to me.



Please don't use AI to write a long, formal application. A short and natural response written in your own words is much more useful to us.



We are hoping to find someone who can become a trusted part of the business over the long term.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR)



Work Setup: Remote

Schedule: Part-Time — 20 Hours per Week

Primary Focus: Lead Generation, Prospect Qualification, Lead Nurturing, Pipeline Management, and Appointment Setting



Position Overview



We are looking for a professional, organized, and AI-comfortable Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR) to support the sales pipeline for two innovative AI solutions:



School Concierge AI — serving the U.S. K–12 education market

e-Discovery AI — serving legal, compliance, records-management, and litigation-support environments



This role goes beyond cold calling and appointment setting. The selected candidate must understand how to move prospects through the sales journey—from initial research and outreach to relationship-building, qualification, ongoing nurturing, and appointment conversion.



The ideal candidate is confident communicating with U.S.-based prospects, understands B2B sales development, and can build trust through consistent, thoughtful follow-up. They should also be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve prospect research, call preparation, outreach personalization, follow-ups, and productivity.



Key Responsibilities

Research and identify potential prospects within the U.S. K–12 education, legal, compliance, and professional-services markets

Identify key decision-makers within schools, school districts, law firms, legal departments, and businesses

Conduct outbound cold calls, warm calls,
s, and LinkedIn outreach using approved scripts and messaging

Introduce solutions clearly and confidently while tailoring conversations to each prospect’s needs

Qualify leads based on their needs, challenges, authority, interest, timing, and potential fit

Understand each prospect’s position within the sales funnel and determine the appropriate next step

Build relationships with prospects who may not be ready to schedule an appointment immediately

Nurture warm and long-term leads through consistent, value-driven follow-ups

Re-engage unresponsive, inactive, or previously contacted prospects

Address initial questions and objections using approved sales materials and objection-handling guides

Schedule qualified discovery calls, demonstrations, and follow-up meetings with the leadership team

Maintain accurate CRM or pipeline records, including contact information, call notes, objections, lead status, follow-up dates, and next steps

Track daily outreach activities, conversations, qualified leads, follow-ups, and scheduled appointments

Collaborate with leadership to improve outreach strategies, messaging, scripts, and lead-nurturing sequences

Participate in product, sales, CRM, script, qualification, and objection-handling training

Follow all confidentiality, privacy, and responsible data-handling requirements

Qualifications

Strong spoken and written English with professional communication skills

Previous experience in sales development, business development, B2B outreach, cold calling, lead generation, appointment setting, telemarketing, or sales support

Understanding of the sales funnel and how to move leads from initial contact to qualification and conversion

Experience nurturing leads through multiple calls,
s, or follow-up touchpoints

Ability to build rapport and maintain relationships without using overly aggressive sales tactics

Comfortable communicating with prospects during agreed-upon U.S. business hours

Able to follow scripts and sales processes while sounding natural, warm, curious, and confident

Strong listening, research, organization, and note-taking skills

Able to recognize prospect needs, buying signals, concerns, and objections

Disciplined with follow-ups, pipeline management, and activity tracking

Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to support sales activities

Reliable, professional, coachable, goal-oriented, and receptive to feedback

Willing to learn about the U.S. K–12 education and legal/e-Discovery markets

Tools You Should Know or Be Willing to Learn

ChatGPT and Perplexity

Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

LinkedIn

CRM and sales-pipeline management platforms

Zoom or Google Meet

Phone or VoIP calling platforms

Internal tracking systems and shared documents



Experience with Claude, Apollo, Seamless.AI, Notion, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Canva, or similar tools is a plus.



Preferred Experience

Supporting U.S.-based companies, founders, consultants, agencies, or sales teams

Calling and nurturing prospects from U.S. businesses, schools, school districts, law firms, SaaS companies, or professional-service organizations

Working as an SDR, BDR, Business Development Specialist, Appointment Setter, Lead Generation Specialist, Sales Virtual Assistant, or Executive Assistant

Managing a CRM, sales pipeline, lead stages, follow-up schedules, or outreach sequences

Qualifying prospects and booking discovery calls or product demonstrations

Exposure to education, legal services, compliance, technology, artificial intelligence, SaaS, or B2B sales

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:



Consistent outbound outreach activity

Meaningful conversations with qualified prospects

Accurate lead qualification and CRM documentation

Timely and consistent follow-ups

Movement of leads through the sales pipeline

Re-engagement of warm or inactive prospects

Qualified discovery calls and demonstrations scheduled

Professional communication and responsible handling of information

AI and Confidentiality Requirements



AI tools may only be used within approved workflows. Team members must never upload student information, legal documents, client files, contracts, discovery materials, or confidential business data into an AI tool without specific authorization.



This is a sales development and business development position. The selected candidate will not provide legal, compliance, privacy, education, or technical advice.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer / Technical Lead
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on senior engineer to build and improve an existing AI-powered outreach/prospecting platform, helping mature it into a secure, scalable B2B SaaS product capable of supporting up to 1,000 users.



This is a highly execution-focused role working directly with the founder. The founder will set the product and technical direction; your responsibility is to turn that direction into a well-built, reliable production system. Put simply: we d
 what needs to be built, and you own building it properly.



You’ll work hands-on across the stack, improving the database structure and data model, implementing proper multi-tenant authentication and permissions, hardening the platform for production, and continuously shipping new features and system improvements.



You’ll have significant ownership over implementation and engineering quality, but this is not a CTO or technical strategy role. We’re looking for an excellent builder who can take requirements and technical direction from the founder and execute them independently.



Essential requirements

• 3+ years building and working on production SaaS products, ideally at senior or lead engineer level.

• Strong TypeScript full-stack experience: React, Node.js/Express, APIs, and PostgreSQL.

• Excellent PostgreSQL data modelling, migrations, query performance, indexing, backups, and safe handling of existing customer data.

• Proven experience turning an MVP or existing product into a reliable production SaaS - not just building greenfield demos.

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture: organisations/workspaces, user roles, permissions, tenant data isolation, and admin access.

• Strong authentication and security knowledge: RBAC, API authorization, secure session handling, secrets management, rate limiting, and OWASP best practices.

• Experience running production systems: cloud deployments, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, error handling, background jobs, queues, retries, and third-party API integrations.

• Able to take clearly defined product and technical requirements and independently translate them into robust, maintainable implementations.

• Comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast-moving environment, shipping quickly while maintaining strong engineering standards.



Preferred

• Experience with AI/LLM products, CRM, sales outreach, workflow automation, data enrichment, or B2B SaaS.

• Familiarity with React, Vite, Node/Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Clerk/Auth0-style authentication, and OpenAPI/Zod.

• Experience with SaaS billing, analytics, and customer account lifecycle management.



We are not looking for a frontend-only developer, someone who only builds simple websites, or someone looking to define the company's technical strategy. The technical and product direction will come from the founder.



We need a strong senior engineer who can take that direction, understand the desired outcome, and build it - safely improving an existing system, establishing high engineering standards, and taking ownership of implementation from requirement through to production.

title: Site Manager / Regional Director - Philippines
description:
Reports to: Global CEO, CFO, COO

Work Setup: Onsite - Manila office (BGC/Taguig area)

Scope: REMBOX Philippines regional operations (production, people, admin, office setup)



This is a senior leadership role responsible for establishing and managing REMBOX's regional operations in the Philippines. The Site Manager will be the most senior person on the ground, building the Manila office from its foundation and leading all production teams to ensure the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and professionalism.



About REMBOX

REMBOX is an international architectural and engineering company that partners with leading design organizations in Israel and the United States. We are a team of architects, engineers, BIM managers, and visualizers dedicated to designing innovative cities and bringing large-scale projects to life. With over 500 staff across four offices in Belarus, REMBOX is expanding into the Philippines and seeks a strong leader to establish and manage the new Manila office.



Core Guiding Principle

"People in our hearts, clients are on our minds, and quality and professionalism are in our bones."



The Site Manager must ensure all employees embody this principle, maintaining high-quality standards, strict adherence to deadlines, and a strong client focus.



Three Primary Focus Areas

Professionalism & Client Orientation: Minimize client complaints regarding quality control and project deadlines.

People Development & Well-Being: Maintain low employee turnover (max 8%), foster growth, ensure good communication, and provide a positive work environment.

Company Representation & Values: Uphold and promote the REMBOX brand, integrity, and values, acting as the company's primary representative.



About the Role

This founding leadership role operates in two distinct phases:



Phase 1: Establishment Phase (Months 1-4 approx.)

Focus: Heavy administrative tasks including office setup, equipment sourcing, service provider selection, lease negotiation, and vendor management to establish the Philippines entity and operationalize the office.



Phase 2: Management Phase (Month 4+ onwards)

Focus: Full regional leadership, managing production teams, Team Leads, KPIs, BIM standards, HR processes, office administration, and reporting to global leadership. The focus shifts to running and optimizing the region.

This role requires a leader comfortable with both hands-on operational groundwork and strategic C-suite engagement.



Key Responsibilities

Management of Production Teams:

Coordinate Team Leads, conduct syncs, manage risks, allocate clients/projects, and resolve issues.

Monitor production performance, quality control, and reporting; resolve issues promptly.

Ensure regional workload delivery, optimize team utilization, and meet output plans.



Cooperation with the BIM Department:

Ensure team compliance with BIM standards and oversee BIM Department performance.

Plan and oversee the execution of regional BIM tasks.



Interaction with the REMBOX Academy:

Monitor Team Lead adherence to Academy standards and methodologies.

Provide feedback to the Academy on training effectiveness and contribute to new system development.

Participate in training new and existing Team Leads.



People Management - HR & Talent:

Participate in recruitment by assessing new employees and managing assignments.

Support retention by resolving conflicts and addressing burnout/motivation issues.

Propose promotions, professional development, and participate in employee evaluations.



Administrative Management of the Region:

Office Setup & Establishment (Philippines-specific): Lead end-to-end office setup, including space negotiation, supplier engagement, and coordination with Corporate Admin and CEO on compliance and financial setup.

Manage System Administrators and coordinate with central IT.

Monitor and enforce office security, data confidentiality, and workplace safety.

Oversee adherence to workplace rules, including working hours, vacation, and sick leave processes.

Manage the local budget, office expenses, and equipment purchases.



Reporting to Global Leadership (CEO, CFO, COO):

Report on regional KPIs (output, deadlines, quality, turnover).

Provide early risk reporting (delays, client issues, staff shortages).

Participate in strategic planning (growth forecasts, resource needs).

Escalate urgent, critical issues.



Must-Have:

Proven experience leading regional operations or large production teams.

Strong organizational and workflow control skills (deadlines, quality, reporting, problem-solving).

Experience managing resource allocation in a multi-project environment.

Ability to analyze team performance and intervene effectively.

Experience in technical or standards-driven environments (e.g., BIM).

Strong people-management skills.

Experience managing office operations through an Office Manager and SysAdmin.

Understanding of workplace safety, data confidentiality, and internal regulations.

Ability to oversee adherence to working-time rules, vacations, and sick leaves.

Experience handling a local budget.

Strong focus on KPIs.

Proactive risk identification and escalation skills.

Experience working directly with C-level executives.

High sense of ownership.

Excellent communication skills in English.



Nice-to-Have:

Background in architecture, engineering, construction, or AEC industry.

Experience setting up a new office or regional entity from scratch.

Experience sourcing and engaging service providers.

Experience with lease negotiations, vendor management, and supplier evaluation.

Experience working with BIM-driven engineering or design teams.

Familiarity with outsourcing or BPO-style production environments.

Experience managing cross-cultural or international teams.

Experience with talent development, internal academies, or training program implementation.



What REMBOX Offers

A founding leadership role as the most senior REMBOX representative in the Philippines.

Direct reporting line and collaboration with the global CEO, CFO, and COO.

The opportunity to build a new operation from the ground up.

A high-visibility, high-impact role.

Official employment: starts as a B2B contract, transitioning to direct employment.

Exposure to an international company culture.

Long-term career opportunity.



Compensation & Employment Structure

Phase 1 (First 3 months): USD 700-1,100/month (salary range provided in original posting, kept as is for accuracy).

Phase 2 (Month 4 onwards): New compensation plan based on performance and regional growth.

Phase 1 Contract: B2B Contract (independent contractor).

Phase 2 Contract: Direct employment through REMBOX Philippines entity.

Transition: Approximately month 4 onwards, aligned with entity establishment and team growth.

The initial B2B arrangement covers the establishment phase. Once the entity is fully operational, the engagement transitions to direct employment with a revised compensation plan.



Recruitment Process

Stage 1: Initial Interview (Background, leadership experience, fit assessment).

Stage 2: CEO / Leadership Interview (Role expectations, company vision, strategic fit).

Stage 3: Offer (Compensation discussion and offer).

This is a senior leadership hire. Only candidates with demonstrated experience managing regional operations or large production teams will be considered.

title: Electrical Power Supply Design Engineer
description:
REMBOX is a team of architects, engineers, BIM managers, and visualizers united by an ambitious goal: to design beautiful cities and bring incredible projects to life with passion and professionalism. We collaborate with renowned studios from Israel and the USA, transforming large-scale ideas into reality. With over 500 staff across four offices in Belarus (Minsk, Brest, Grodno, and Gomel), REMBOX is expanding into the Philippines and seeking talented engineering professionals to join us.



We serve as a strategic partner for leading design organizations in Israel and the United States, delivering architectural, structural, MEP, and BIM services for large-scale projects across residential, commercial, public, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.



About the Role

REMBOX Philippines is looking for a skilled and motivated Electrical Power Supply Design Engineer. You will design internal and external power supply systems and produce complete electrical drawings and documentation for projects of various scales, collaborating with international project teams.



This is a technically focused engineering role for someone with a strong background in electrical power supply engineering, who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and driven to grow professionally within a world-class international company.



Key Responsibilities

External Power Supply Systems

Design external power supply infrastructure, including high and medium voltage networks, substations, transformer connections, and cable routing.

Design external distribution systems, including overhead lines, underground cable networks, switching stations, and metering points.

Produce drawings and documentation for external electrical networks: plans, cable routing layouts, schematic diagrams, and connection details.



Internal Power Supply Systems

Design internal low voltage distribution systems: main distribution boards, sub-distribution panels, busbar trunking, and cable distribution.

Design internal electrical systems for buildings: lighting, power outlets, socket layouts, emergency lighting, and UPS systems.

Design emergency and standby power systems: generator connections, automatic transfer switches, and critical load distribution.

Design earthing and lightning protection systems.

Produce internal electrical drawings: floor plans, riser diagrams, single-line diagrams, load calculations, and cable schedules.



Documentation & Coordination

Produce complete electrical engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, including plans, schematics, single-line diagrams, sections, details, and specifications.

Develop and maintain electrical BIM models in Autodesk Revit where required, adhering to project BIM standards.

Create electrical designs for projects of various scales and typologies, including residential complexes, public buildings, office developments, industrial, and infrastructure.

Coordinate electrical designs with architectural, structural, mechanical, and plumbing disciplines to resolve clashes and ensure integration.

Ensure all designs comply with applicable international codes, standards, and project specifications.

Update documentation based on design revisions, coordination outcomes, and client feedback.

Participate in technical coordination meetings and contribute to project delivery.



We are looking for candidates who meet the following qualifications:



Education & Experience

Higher technical education in Electrical Engineering or Power Supply Engineering.

Proven professional experience designing external and/or internal electrical power supply systems.

Experience producing complete electrical engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD.



Skills & Competencies — Must-Have

Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for electrical engineering drawing and documentation.

Solid understanding of external power supply system design (HV/MV networks, substations, cable routing, transformer connections).

Solid understanding of internal power supply system design (LV distribution, panels, lighting, power, emergency systems).

Ability to produce engineering drawings (plans, schematics, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, load calculations).

Understanding of electrical load analysis, short-circuit calculations, and protection coordination.

Strong attention to detail and diligence in completing assigned tasks accurately.

Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

Self-motivated with a genuine drive for professional growth.

Ability to manage workload and meet project deadlines independently.



Skills & Competencies — Strong Advantage

Experience with Autodesk Revit for MEP/electrical BIM modeling.

Familiarity with BIM coordination workflows and clash detection across disciplines.

Experience working on international projects or with international electrical design standards (IEC, NEC, Israeli standards).

Experience coordinating electrical designs with architects, structural engineers, and other MEP disciplines.

Experience with electrical design software for load calculations or network analysis.



Nice-to-Have

Experience with fire alarm systems, structured cabling, or building automation systems (BAS/BMS).

Background in renewable energy systems or EV charging infrastructure design.

Experience working in an international or remote team environment.

Familiarity with Israeli or US electrical design standards.



What REMBOX Offers

Employment via B2B contract.

Work on interesting, large-scale international projects in Israel and the USA.

Opportunities for professional growth and self-fulfillment within a growing global company.

Exposure to new technologies, including work in the BIM environment.

A collaborative, people-centered work culture with like-minded engineering professionals.

Clear pathway to grow alongside the company as the Manila office expands.

Be part of the founding team of REMBOX Philippines — a unique opportunity at an exciting stage.
