title: Spanish Content QA Assistant – YouTube Script Production (Claude AI)
description:
IMPORTANT: This job requires advanced or native-level Castilian Spanish. This is non-negotiable. If you do not have a strong command of written Spanish from Spain, please do not apply.



---



WHAT THIS JOB IS



I run a Spanish-language YouTube channel focused on Stoic philosophy for sleep and mental wellness. I need a virtual assistant to help manage the production of long-form scripts using a fully systematized process powered by Claude AI.



This is NOT a writing or creative job. You will not be writing scripts. You will be operating a system. Everything you need is provided: 



A detailed onboarding document

Word files to attach to Claude

Exact prompts to copy and paste at each step

A quality checklist to follow when reviewing the output. 



Your job is to execute the process precisely and pay very close attention to the corrections that need to be requested from Claude, following the quality requirements exactly.



The key skill this job requires is not creativity or knowledge of the topic. It is the ability to follow a detailed system step by step, read carefully, and apply correction criteria with precision and consistency.



---



WHAT THE PROCESS LOOKS LIKE



Step 1 — You set up a Claude project using the documents and instructions we provide. This takes around 5 minutes and is fully explained in the onboarding document.



Step 2 — Using the exact prompts we give you, you generate the script lesson by lesson inside the Claude project. Claude does all the writing. Each script contains approximately 30,000 words generated automatically by Claude. Your role is not to write the content yourself. Instead, you will supervise the generation process, review each lesson using the provided quality checklist, and request corrections when needed. The writing itself is handled by Claude; your responsibility is quality control and ensuring that the output meets the standards defined in the system.



Step 3 — You review each lesson against a detailed quality checklist we provide. When something does not meet the criteria, you request specific corrections from Claude following the exact instructions we give you for each type of issue. The checklist tells you exactly what to look for and how to ask for changes.



Step 4 — You deliver the completed and reviewed script as a Word document.



Every single step is documented. You will never need to improvise or make creative decisions. What is required is careful attention, precision, and a genuine commitment to following the process correctly.



---



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A complete onboarding document explaining every step of the process

- All Word documents to attach to the Claude project

- The exact prompts to use at each moment of the process

- A detailed quality checklist with specific criteria and instructions for every type of correction

- Full support during the first script to answer any questions (we strongly encourage asking questions at any point, especially during the first script — the sooner any doubt is raised, the faster the process becomes fully manageable and the easier it is to correct course before too much work has been done)



---



REQUIREMENTS



- Advanced or native Castilian Spanish. This is the most critical requirement. The channel uses only standard Spanish from Spain and you need to read and evaluate the text accurately.

- Access to Claude.ai Pro plan ($20/month). This is the tool used for all script generation. It is required to do this job.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written instructions with precision.

- Reliable availability and consistent communication.



---



VOLUME AND SCOPE



We produce approximately 1 script every 2 days. Each script contains between 20 and 25 lessons and totals around 30,000 words — generated by Claude following the system, not written manually by you.



We will start with a paid trial of 1 complete script. If the process goes well and the quality meets the standards, the first project will consist of 10 scripts. The goal is to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.



---



TO APPLY





Please write your application in Spanish and tell us:



Your Spanish level and how you acquired it.



Your experience with AI tools — especially giving precise correction instructions to get specific results.



Can you spot typical AI writing patterns in Spanish text — repetitive structures, formulaic phrases, transitions that feel unnatural or interchangeable between paragraphs? If so, could you give us 3 or 4 concrete examples of the kind of constructions you would flag? This is one of the most important skills for this role.



Any experience following detailed checklists or quality control processes.



Applications in English only will not be considered.

title: Video Editor for Meta ads
description:
WHAT THIS IS

We're an Australian jewelry brand. We make personalized 18K gold plated jewelry — names, birthstones, initials — and we've served over 500,000 customers since 2022.

Almost all our growth comes from video ads on
 and Instagram, and we ship around 100 new creatives a week. We have more good footage and more good briefs than we have hands to cut them. That's the job.

This is a long-term, ongoing role. We are not looking for a project freelancer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cut finished 9:16 vertical ads from written briefs and raw creator footage, plus 4:5 and 1:1 versions

- Re-cut the opening 3 seconds of winning ads into 2–3 alternate hooks — a big part of the role

- Burned-in captions, properly timed — not raw auto-transcription

- Text overlays, price cards and call-to-action end frames

- Audio cleanup: levels, noise, ducking

- Colour matching across creators shot in different lighting

- Naming and delivering files to our convention

- 20–30 finished variants a week once you're up to speed



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years on short-form vertical, including at least 1 year on direct-response ADS (Meta, TikTok, Shorts). Wedding films and long-form YouTube alone won't be enough here.

- Experienced in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

- Fast and comfortable in CapCut. Most of our volume is quick variants, and that's where speed matters.

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A machine that handles a multi-layer 4K timeline: M1 Mac or better with 16GB+, or Windows with 16GB+ and a dedicated GPU. Plus 50 Mbps+ internet with a backup connection. Please don't apply if your setup is below this — it makes the turnaround times impossible and neither of us will enjoy it.



HOURS AND PAY

- 20–25 hrs/week, Monday to Friday. You pick your window as long as it overlaps at least 3 hours with Australian business hours — 9am to 2pm Philippine time works well.

- Rate is negotiable and based on experience — tell us your hourly rate in USD and we'll work from there. Paid twice monthly by Wise.

- Option to go full-time.



THE TRIAL EDIT

We're not going to hire off a résumé. We want to see you cut one ad.

Everything you need is in this folder:







Inside you'll find the creator clips and the product b-roll. That's all we're giving you — for the product, the brand and who we sell to, go to 
 and have a look around.

We have deliberately NOT included examples of our existing ads. We want to see how you'd approach this, not how well you can copy us.

MAKE US ONE AD:

- 9:16 vertical, exported as MP4

- Keep the jewelry clear and central — we need to see the necklace, and the initial on the heart should be legible

- Add background music

- There's no script and that's deliberate. The clips are all there — how you arrange them into an ad is the part we want to see. Order, structure, length, pacing, hook, on-screen text: all yours.

- Budget about 2 hours. We've pulled out the usable clips for you so you're not wading through a full footage dump. We know it's still real time and we don't ask for it lightly — but this is a long-term position and we want to get it right, so we'd rather see one ad you actually cut than read twenty résumés.



HOW TO APPLY

Four things. OnlineJobs.ph can't take file attachments, so everything below needs to be a link — Google Drive, Dropbox or an unlisted YouTube video. Paste them into your application message.

- Your trial edit — a Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link. Please check the sharing is set so we can actually open it.

- Your résumé and a link to your portfolio or reel.

- Your available hours per week and the daily window you'd work, in Philippine time.

- Your hourly rate in USD. Give a number — “negotiable” tells us nothing.

We really appreciate the time everyone puts into this. We'll do our best to get back to everyone who submits an edit.

title: Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor – Dropshipping & Meta Ads About the Role
description:
We are building a performance-focused dropshipping operation across multiple international markets and are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor to help us build our creative department.



This is NOT a traditional branding position.



Our business is built around fast product testing, competitor research, high-quality creative execution and systematic scaling of winning products.



Creative output is one of the most important parts of our entire operation. We are therefore looking for someone who understands both sides:



Strategy + Execution.



You should understand how to find winning concepts, turn them into structured tests, create clear Creative Briefs and work hands-on with editors to produce high-quality ads.



Initially, this position will start on a smaller scale as a test phase. If the collaboration and results are strong, the goal is to develop this into a long-term Creative Team Lead position and build the creative team together.



How Our Creative Testing Works



Understanding our process is important.



Stage 1: Product Testing



When testing a new product, we start with proven competitor ads.



These creatives need to be recreated and localized at a very high standard.



We care about:



Accurate localization and translation

High-quality video and image execution

Matching the original creative structure

Matching the pacing, voiceover and overall feel of the reference

Correct product, offer and funnel information

Clean and professional execution



The goal is not to unnecessarily reinvent a proven concept during the initial test.



The goal is to create a high-quality version of an already validated creative so we can properly test the product and offer.



Stage 2: Scaling Winning Products



Once a product passes our initial testing phase, creative strategy becomes much more important.



You will:



Find additional competitor ads and concepts

Research competitors continuously

Identify new hooks and angles

Analyze existing winning ads

Create iterations of winning creatives

Build structured A/B tests

Write Creative Briefs for editors

Coordinate production of new ads



We don't want random creative variations.



Every new creative should have a reason for being tested and, where possible, isolate variables so we can understand what actually improved or hurt performance.



Stage 3: Expanding Beyond Competitor Ads



Eventually, competitor creatives alone are not enough.



At this stage, you should be able to expand the creative library through:



Reinterpreting winning ads from other products or markets

Taking proven creative structures and applying a different angle

Developing new concepts from scratch

Using current market and advertising trends

Following our internal SOPs and frameworks

Creating new hooks, angles and formats based on actual performance data



The objective is to continuously increase creative output without simply producing more of the same.



Awareness & Funnel Understanding



You should understand that not every customer needs to see the same message.



Experience with concepts such as:



Customer Awareness Stages

Top of Funnel (TOF)

Middle of Funnel (MOF)

Bottom of Funnel (BOF)

Problem-aware vs. solution-aware audiences

Different hooks and angles for different levels of awareness



is important.



When developing new concepts, we want our creative library to cover different awareness stages instead of targeting every customer with the same message.



Your Responsibilities

Creative Research & Strategy

Research competitors and their advertising

Find strong reference ads for new product tests

Identify winning hooks, angles and creative structures

Monitor creative trends in the market

Analyze existing winners and develop new iterations

Create structured Creative Briefs

Plan A/B tests and creative variations

Develop concepts from scratch when competitor material becomes limited

Creative Production



You must also be comfortable working hands-on.



You should be able to:



Recreate competitor creatives at a high standard

Produce Meta video and image ads

Edit voiceovers, subtitles, visuals and pacing

Work with UGC and existing media

Create AI-generated assets when required

Turn Creative Briefs into finished ads

Quality Control



A major part of this position is ensuring that our creative output maintains a consistently high standard.



You will review creatives for:



Translation and localization quality

Visual accuracy

Voiceover quality

Pacing and editing

Correct offers and product information

Consistency with the reference or Creative Brief

Overall readiness before creatives go live

Building the Creative Team



This role starts hands-on.



We are NOT looking for someone who only wants to manage other people.



However, our long-term goal is to build a dedicated creative team around this position.



If the test phase is successful, you will have the opportunity to become our Creative Team Lead.



Together, we will:



Hire additional editors

Build efficient workflows

Create and improve SOPs

Assign Creative Briefs

Review editor output

Maintain quality standards

Increase daily creative output

Develop a scalable creative production system across different markets



If you already know talented editors or other potential creative team members you have successfully worked with before, that is a strong plus.



Experience We're Looking For



Ideally, you already have experience with:



Dropshipping

Meta /
 Ads

Performance creative production

Creative strategy

Competitor ad research

Creative Brief creation

Direct-response advertising

Creative testing and A/B testing

Awareness stages and funnel concepts

Scaling winning products through additional creatives



Previous experience working inside a high-volume dropshipping operation or performance marketing team is a major advantage.



Tools



You should be comfortable with modern creative production tools such as:



CapCut

Adobe Premiere Pro / Photoshop or similar

ElevenLabs

Higgsfield

Magnific

Freepik

AI image and video generation tools



You don't need to know every tool we use from day one.



More important is that you understand how to use modern AI and editing tools to achieve high-quality output quickly and efficiently.



Who We're Looking For



You should be someone who:



Understands the dropshipping testing and scaling environment

Thinks strategically but is still willing to execute

Has a strong eye for performance creatives

Can distinguish between copying a winner and strategically iterating a winner

Understands Creative Briefs

Understands A/B testing

Can work quickly without sacrificing quality

Is highly organized and reliable

Takes ownership

Communicates clearly in English

Can eventually coordinate and lead other editors



We care less about cinematic editing and more about your ability to create high-quality ads that are built to convert.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are starting this position at a smaller scale to test the collaboration, workflow and results.



If it works, this is intended to become a long-term position with significantly more responsibility.



Our goal is to build a creative department capable of supporting multiple products and markets with a consistently high creative output.



For the right person, this means the opportunity to grow from a hands-on Creative Strategist into the person responsible for creative strategy, production and eventually the creative team itself.



How to Apply

The tools you currently use

Tell us whether you have previously managed editors or have editors you have successfully worked with before



Please do not send only a general video editing portfolio.



We want to see that you understand the complete process:



Research ? Competitor Ads ? Testing ? Analysis ? Iteration ? Creative Briefs ? Scaling.

title: Google & Shopify Product Lister — AI-Assisted Dropshipping
description:
We are looking for an experienced Google & Shopify Product Lister who is highly comfortable with dropshipping stores, especially in Fashion and Home & Decor.



This is not a basic product-uploading role. Our product listing process is AI-assisted, so the main responsibility of the lister is to prepare the required information in the sheet, review the listings generated by AI, identify mistakes, and make sure the final listings meet our quality standards.



We are looking for someone who has a very good eye for product listings and understands what makes a listing good or bad.



What You’ll Be Doing

Filling and maintaining product listing sheets with accurate product information.

Working with AI-generated product titles, descriptions, keywords, and other listing information.

Carefully reviewing AI-generated listings before they are used on our stores.

Identifying and correcting mistakes made by AI.

Checking whether the title actually matches the product shown in the images.

Checking whether the keywords are relevant and make sense for the product.

Identifying keyword stuffing, unnatural wording, irrelevant keywords, or misleading product information.

Making sure product titles are suitable for Google Shopping and SEO.

Reviewing existing listings and identifying which listings are strong and which need improvement.

Improving AI-generated listings when necessary rather than blindly accepting the AI output.

Working with multiple Shopify stores and potentially different markets/languages.

Maintaining consistent listing quality across large product catalogs.

Using Google Sheets and other tools required for the product listing workflow.

AI-Assisted Workflow



A significant part of this role will involve working alongside AI.



AI will handle much of the initial listing generation, but AI is not perfect and can make mistakes such as:



Choosing irrelevant keywords.

Misunderstanding what a product actually is.

Using keywords that don't match the product.

Creating unnatural or poorly structured titles.

Adding information that cannot be verified from the product.

Using incorrect product categories.

Missing important search terms.

Producing listings that technically look correct but are not commercially useful.



Your job is to catch these mistakes.



You should have a strong enough understanding of ecommerce, SEO, Google Shopping, and product listings to quickly identify when an AI-generated listing is not good enough.



We are looking for someone who can say:



"AI generated this listing, but this isn't right because the product should be positioned differently and these keywords don't make sense."



rather than someone who simply checks whether the AI has filled every column.



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate should:



Have hands-on experience with Shopify.

Have strong experience with dropshipping.

Have experience with Fashion and/or Home & Decor stores.

Understand Google Shopping product listings.

Have a strong understanding of SEO keywords and search intent.

Be able to identify high-intent and commercially relevant keywords.

Have a very good eye for identifying good vs. bad product listings.

Be able to review AI-generated content critically.

Have strong attention to detail.

Understand product categorization and product positioning.

Be comfortable working with Google Sheets.

Be able to work independently and make sensible decisions without needing step-by-step instructions for every product.

Experience With Successful Stores



Preference will be given to candidates who have already worked on successful dropshipping stores, particularly stores using Google Shopping or similar advertising channels.



If you have previously worked on stores that were generating consistent sales, please mention this in your application and explain what type of products/stores you worked with.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



This role is not suitable for someone who only knows how to upload products to Shopify.



We are not looking for someone who will simply:



Fill the sheet → Let AI generate everything → Accept the output → Move on.



We need someone who can review, question, correct, and improve the output.



The ability to spot small mistakes that could negatively affect a product's SEO, Google Shopping relevance, or customer understanding is extremely important.



Compensation



$3/hour



We are also open to discussing a fixed monthly arrangement after evaluating your skills, speed, accuracy, and overall quality of work.



We will initially evaluate your skills before committing to a longer-term monthly arrangement.



Selection Process



Candidates may be given a small practical test involving product sheets, AI-generated listings, SEO keywords, and product evaluation.



The test will evaluate:



SEO keyword understanding

Google Shopping knowledge

Shopify experience

Dropshipping experience

Understanding of Fashion/Home & Decor products

Ability to identify AI mistakes

Ability to improve weak listings

Attention to detail

Speed and accuracy

Overall judgment when reviewing product listings



If you already have relevant experience, please include examples of the Shopify/dropshipping stores or types of products you have worked with in your application.



We are looking for someone who can become the quality-control eye behind our AI-assisted product listing process.

title: FB + Google Media Buyer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta + Google Media Buyer to manage and optimize a large-scale paid advertising account across Meta and Google.



This is a part-time role for someone who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing $2M+ per month in advertising spend. We are looking for more than someone who simply maintains campaigns. You should actively look for opportunities to improve performance, bring new testing ideas to the table, and help us scale profitably.



Responsibilities



- Manage and optimize $2M+ in monthly advertising spend across Meta and Google.

 - Launch, manage, and scale campaigns across:

Meta Ads

Google Search

Google Shopping

Performance Max

YouTube and other relevant Google placements



- Monitor campaign performance daily and make adjustments based on profitability and business objectives.

- Upload and launch new creatives, ads, copy, and campaigns accurately and efficiently.

- Maintain proper campaign structure, naming conventions, tracking, budgets, and attribution.

- Analyze performance across campaigns, audiences, creatives, products, and landing pages.

- Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.

- Proactively bring new campaign strategies, tests, and ideas to the team rather than simply executing instructions.

- Develop and run structured tests involving:

Campaign structures

Audiences

Bidding strategies

Creative

Offers

Landing pages

Account optimization strategies



-Work closely with the creative team to communicate which creatives, angles, hooks, and concepts are performing.

-Identify creative fatigue and recommend when new concepts or iterations are needed.

-Troubleshoot performance drops, tracking issues, disapproved ads, account problems, and other campaign issues.

-Produce clear performance reporting and explain what happened, why it happened, and what we should do next.

-Maintain an extremely high level of accuracy when making changes to high-spend accounts.



What We're Looking For



- Significant hands-on experience managing Meta and Google Ads.

- Proven experience managing large advertising budgets. Experience with $2M+/month in ad spend is strongly preferred.

- Strong understanding of direct-response and performance marketing.

- Comfortable making decisions in accounts spending tens of thousands of dollars per day.

- Deep understanding of metrics including:

ROAS

MER

CPA/CAC

CPM

CTR

CPC

CVR

AOV

Contribution margin



- Highly analytical and able to turn campaign data into actionable decisions.

- Excellent attention to detail. Small mistakes become expensive at our level of spend.

- Strong understanding of campaign scaling, budget allocation, attribution, and bidding strategies.

- Comfortable analyzing performance beyond Ads Manager and Google Ads.

- Able to work independently without needing constant direction.

- Proactive and constantly looking for new opportunities to improve performance.

- Organized and able to manage a high volume of campaigns, creatives, and tests simultaneously.



You Would Be a Great Fit If



You don't just ask:



"What campaigns do you want me to launch?"



You naturally think:



"Here's what I'm seeing in the data, here's the opportunity, and here are the three things I think we should test next."



We want someone who combines strong execution with strategic thinking.



You should be comfortable digging through data, spotting patterns, forming hypotheses, launching tests, and using the results to determine what we do next.



To Apply



Please include:



- Your experience managing Meta and Google Ads.

- The largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed.

- Examples of accounts or brands you have helped scale.

- Your experience with direct-response/e-commerce advertising.

title: Property Operations & Executive Assistant (Real Estate VA — Australian Company)
description:
We're a growing Australian property renovation and investment business. We buy, renovate and resell residential properties, and we're looking for a highly organised Property Operations & Executive Assistant to become a key part of our business.



This is a hands-on, long-term role for someone who loves organisation, follow-through and getting things done. You'll work directly with the owner across property acquisition, renovation projects, administration and marketing.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete tasks — you notice what's outstanding, follow things through, and help keep the business moving.



WORKING HOURS: Monday–Friday, full-time, aligned to Brisbane, Australia business hours (approx. 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM Manila time).



Please note: this role includes daily phone calls to Australian real estate agents, so confident, clear spoken English and comfort on the phone are essential.



You'll work across four areas:



1) OPERATIONS & PROJECT COORDINATION (the core of the role)

- Start each day by working through a prepared report — reply to or action flagged
s, and prepare and schedule invoices and bills for payment (for the owner's approval)

- Maintain task lists and follow-ups across several active property projects at once

- Proactively chase outstanding quotes, documents, deliveries and responses rather than waiting to be reminded

- Coordinate renovation projects: book quotes and trades (as directed), order materials, and track deliveries

- Coordinate sale preparation: book photographers, stylists, cleaners, floorplans and agents

- Collect and organise compliance documents (trade licences, insurances, smoke-alarm certificates, warranties)

- Liaise with solicitors, and handle council, utility and body-corporate admin as needed

- Keep project information, documents and correspondence organised and easy to retrieve



2) AGENT RELATIONSHIPS & PROPERTY LEAD GENERATION

- Call our database of real estate agents on a regular cycle to maintain relationships and uncover off-market, pre-market and renovation opportunities

- Keep accurate notes and follow-up dates in the CRM

- Identify promising opportunities and escalate them to the owner quickly

- Follow up consistently so opportunities don't slip away through lack of contact



3) PROPERTY / DEAL SCREENING

- Run a quick feasibility on potential properties using our simple in-house tool

- Pull comparable-sales (CMA) reports using our property-data login

- Package the numbers into a clean summary for the owner to review



4) CONTENT & SOCIAL MEDIA

- Turn supplied project footage into simple, polished reels using our established templates

- Captions, hooks and text-overlay direction are provided through our existing AI system

- Schedule approved content across our business and personal accounts (daily posting)

- Maintain an organised content library of project footage, before/afters and completed assets



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proactive and resourceful — if something is outstanding, you'll chase it, solve it, or bring it to our attention rather than waiting to be asked

- Strong attention to detail — names, numbers, dates and documents need to be accurate

- Excellent spoken and written English — you're comfortable calling and speaking with Australians every day

- Confident on the phone; not afraid of relationship/outreach calling

- Highly organised and reliable — you follow through and nothing slips through the cracks

- Comfortable juggling several projects and priorities at once

- Real estate, property or construction admin experience is a strong advantage

- Social media / basic reel editing (CapCut or similar) and scheduling experience

- Good with
, spreadsheets and project/CRM tools; quick to learn new systems

- Trustworthy with sensitive financial and business information



WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Direct access to the business owner and clear priorities

- Established systems, templates and AI tools designed to make the role easier

- Training across our property acquisition and renovation processes

- Increasing autonomy and responsibility as you learn the business

- A stable, full-time, long-term position



COMPENSATION: USD $1,000–$1,300/month depending on experience, with formal performance and salary reviews as the role develops.



HOW TO APPLY

Please start your application with the word RENOVATE so we know you've read this far. Then tell us, in a few sentences:

1. Your experience with phone calls and speaking with international (ideally Australian or Western) clients

2. Any real estate or property admin experience you have

3. Your experience creating and scheduling social media reels

4. Your typical internet speed and your home working setup (headset, backup power/internet)

5. Scenario: You're managing several renovation tasks and notice a supplier hasn't confirmed a delivery that's required for tomorrow. What would you do?

6. Please include a 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself (attach a file or paste a link), so we can hear your spoken English.



Applications that don't start with the keyword won't be considered. We're excited to find the right long-term person — thank you for reading, and we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Executive Assistant / Personal Operations Assistant
description:
# Executive Assistant / Personal Operations Assistant



**Remote | Philippines | Part-time to start | Long-term opportunity**



I am a Danish entrepreneur based in Switzerland, running two companies, one Danish company and one Swiss company. Both companies primarily serve Danish customers.



I am looking for a highly organized and proactive **Executive Assistant / Personal Operations Assistant** who can become my right hand.



This is **not** a traditional Virtual Assistant position where you wait for me to give you tasks.



I am looking for someone who takes ownership, creates structure, follows up, keeps track of deadlines and helps make sure that nothing important falls through the cracks.



Over time, I want you to know my open tasks, deadlines, follow-ups and administrative responsibilities better than I do.



## The Goal



I have many things happening across two businesses and my personal life.



I don't want to spend my time remembering:



* Who I need to follow up with

* What I promised someone

* What employees or contractors owe me

* Which documents are missing

* What needs to be sent to our accountants

* Which invoices or payments need attention

* What deadlines are coming

* What I need to decide

* What I have delegated

* What I am waiting for

* What I may have forgotten



I want you to help manage this.



My goal is simple:



**I should spend less time remembering, organizing and following up and more time making decisions and growing the businesses.**



## Task & Priority Management



A major part of your role will be helping me manage my tasks and priorities.



You will:



* Maintain and organize my tasks

* Help prioritize what requires my attention

* Capture tasks from Slack messages, voice notes,
s and meetings

* Track deadlines

* Follow up on delegated tasks

* Maintain a clear "waiting for" overview

* Remind me when I need to make a decision

* Follow up with me when I haven't completed something important

* Make sure important things don't get forgotten

* Prepare a short daily overview of my priorities

* Help separate what is urgent from what can wait



I don't want to constantly tell you what to do next.



I want you to gradually take ownership of keeping everything organized.



For example:



I may send you a voice note containing seven random things I just remembered.



I don't want to manually create seven tasks afterwards.



I want you to understand what requires action, organize it in the right place, handle what you can yourself, follow up with other people when necessary and make sure I only need to deal with the things that actually require me.



## Finance & Accounting Administration



This will be an important part of the role.



You do **not** need to be an accountant, but you must be comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and financial information.



I have both a **Danish company and a Swiss company**, so you will help organize financial and administrative information across both companies.



This may include:



* Maintaining business budgets

* Helping maintain personal budgets

* Maintaining cash-flow overviews

* Tracking expenses

* Tracking outstanding customer invoices

* Tracking upcoming payments

* Collecting invoices and receipts

* Finding missing accounting documentation

* Organizing accounting folders

* Preparing documentation for accountants

* Following up on missing information

* Keeping track of subscriptions and recurring expenses

* Preparing simple monthly financial overviews

* Monitoring budget vs. actual spending

* Identifying unusual or missing information



There may be different accountants, currencies such as **DKK and CHF**, different documents and different administrative processes between the two companies.



You are **not expected to understand Danish or Swiss accounting law**. Our accountants handle the professional accounting and compliance.



Your responsibility is organization.



I want you to know:



* What belongs to which company

* What documentation is missing

* What needs to be sent

* Who is waiting for something

* What deadlines are approaching

* What requires my approval



Experience with bookkeeping, budgeting or financial administration is a **major advantage**.



Important payments and financial decisions will remain with me.



## Executive & Personal Assistance



The position includes both business and personal administration.



Over time, this may include:



* Calendar management

* Scheduling and rescheduling meetings

* Research

* Travel planning and booking

* Reservations

* Insurance administration

* Subscription management

* Purchases and returns

* Organizing documents

* Following up with companies and people

* Reminders and appointments

* Researching larger purchases or decisions

* Other practical administrative tasks



If something administrative is repeatedly taking unnecessary time or attention from me, I want us to find a way for you to take ownership of it.



## Systems & Notion



We already use several systems across the businesses.



These currently include:



* **Notion**

* **Slack**

* **HubSpot**

* **Google Workspace / Google Drive**

* **Google Sheets / Excel**



Both companies already have their own Notion environments.



One of the companies also uses HubSpot.



I do **not** want to replace everything or build complicated systems just for the sake of having systems.



Instead, I want you to help me make what we already use work better.



A very important part of this role will be understanding how I work and helping me create a simple system for managing things across my businesses and personal responsibilities.



This may include improving:



* Task management

* My personal priority overview

* Follow-ups

* "Waiting for" items

* Recurring tasks

* Deadlines

* Financial administration

* Document organization

* SOPs

* Information flow between systems

* Daily and weekly routines



I don't expect to hand you a perfect system.



**I want you to help me build and improve it.**



If you see a better way of doing something, I expect you to suggest it.



Your goal is not to create more systems for me to manage.



**Your goal is to make my life simpler.**



Strong Notion experience is therefore a major advantage.



## Slack & Communication



Slack will be our main communication tool.



The working language between you and me will be **English**.



Our team members are comfortable communicating in English, so Slack conversations involving you can normally be in English.



Tasks and systems that you manage can also generally be in English.



However, both companies primarily serve **Danish customers**.



This means a lot of the information you encounter will naturally be in Danish.



This may include:



* Customer
s

* Invoices

* Receipts

* Accounting documents

* Contracts

* Websites

* Existing Notion pages

* Historical Slack conversations

* Customer information

* Letters and other documents



**You do NOT need to speak Danish.**



But Danish should not become a barrier to doing your job independently.



## AI Is Part of the Job



You should be very comfortable using tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools**.



AI should be a normal part of your daily workflow.



If you receive a Danish
, invoice or document, I don't want you to automatically ask me:



*"What does this mean?"*



I expect you to first use the available tools to understand it yourself.



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Translate Danish content

* Understand documents

* Summarize
s

* Extract action items

* Summarize conversations

* Organize information

* Draft responses

* Conduct research

* Analyze information

* Create SOPs

* Improve workflows

* Help structure tasks and priorities



If something is genuinely unclear or requires business context, you should of course ask.



The important thing is that your first instinct should be:



**"Can I figure this out myself?"**



## Who I Am Looking For



You are:



* Extremely organized

* Proactive

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable taking ownership

* Good at prioritizing

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable with numbers

* Strong with Google Sheets / Excel

* Comfortable with Notion

* Comfortable learning new software

* Very comfortable using AI

* A strong English communicator

* Resourceful

* Comfortable following up with other people

* Comfortable reminding me when something hasn't been completed

* Comfortable handling confidential business and personal information



Experience supporting a **founder, CEO or entrepreneur** is highly preferred.



Experience with **bookkeeping, financial administration or budgeting** is highly preferred.



Strong **Notion experience** is highly preferred.



## The Type of Person I DON'T Want



I am not looking for someone who constantly asks:



**"What should I do next?"**



Imagine there are 20 open tasks.



Eventually, I want you to be able to tell me:



**"These three require your attention today. I handled these six. We are waiting for responses on these four. I followed up on these three, and the remaining tasks can wait."**



I want someone who thinks ahead.



I also want someone who isn't afraid to remind me:



**"You still haven't approved this. We need a decision today."**



That's a good thing.



I want you to help protect my attention, not create more things for me to manage.



## Working Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



We will start at approximately **20 hours per week**.



There is some flexibility in how those hours are structured, but we will need some overlap during European business hours.



If we work well together, there is an opportunity for the position to grow significantly in hours, responsibility and salary.



I am looking for someone who wants a **long-term position**, not a short freelance project.



Over time, I want this person to become an important part of how I organize and operate my businesses and personal administration.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with the words:



**"I take ownership."**



Applications that do not start with these words will not be considered.



Then please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. Your experience working directly with founders, CEOs or business owners.

4. An example of a situation where you took ownership of something without being asked.

5. Your experience with Notion.

6. Your experience with bookkeeping, budgets, spreadsheets or financial administration.

7. How you currently use ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools in your work.

8. Which task/project management tools you have used.

9. Your expected hourly rate.

10. Your weekly availability.



### Please Also Answer This Scenario



Imagine I send you a 3-minute voice note.



During the voice note I mention:



* Several things I need to remember

* Four tasks

* Two people I need to follow up with

* Something an employee owes me

* An invoice that hasn't been paid

* Something that needs to be sent to an accountant

* A personal appointment I need to remember



**What would you do after receiving the voice note?**



Explain:



* How you would organize the information

* What you would handle yourself

* What you would need from me

* What you would delegate or follow up on

* How you would make sure nothing gets forgotten



### Short Video Introduction



Please also send a short **2–3 minute video introduction**.



Tell me:



* Who you are

* What kind of Executive Assistant experience you have

* Why this particular position interests you

* Why you think you would be good at creating structure for a busy entrepreneur



The video does not need to be professionally produced.



I simply want to get a feeling for your communication style, personality and English.



## Hiring Process



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short **paid practical test**.



The test will be based on realistic situations from the job.



I will be looking at how you:



* Prioritize

* Organize information

* Work independently

* Use AI

* Work with numbers

title: AI Video Producer — All Styles (Veo 3 / Seedance / Kling): Ads, Explainers, Podcasts, Animation
description:
We produce AI-generated video ads for an e-commerce supplement brand (US market) — at

volume, across EVERY style that's working right now:



- Photoreal "shot on camera" ads (Veo 3-class): AI actors, AI doctors, AI street

  interviews, testimonial-style talking heads

- Podcast clips: AI hosts mid-conversation, mic and studio, clipped like a viral

  podcast moment

- Explainer ads: whiteboard, medical 3D (inside-the-body mechanism shots), diagram overlays

- Animated storytelling: Pixar-style films with recurring characters, mascot musicals

- UGC-style: AI creators, mirror selfies, day-in-the-life

- Product cinematography: hero shots, pours, macro detail



One week you're directing a photoreal AI doctor delivering a 30-second pitch; the next

you're generating shot 31 of a 5-minute animated musical. We have a full production

system — scripts, prompt cards, reference images, timing, and final assembly are all

handled. You are the person who turns direction into finished clips, fast, and keeps

quality ruthlessly consistent.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Generate video with Prompts in Seedance 2.5 (Higgsfield), Veo, Kling —

  attach the right reference images, set duration/resolution exactly as specified

- QUALITY-CHECK every clip before accepting: correct length, characters identical to

  their references across shots (no face/wardrobe drift), lip movement only where

  intended, no garbled text, no extra people, staging matches the card

- Re-roll failed takes and say WHY they failed

- Match a target style on request: we hand you a competitor's ad, you work out how to

  reproduce that look

- Keep files named and organized to our convention

- SPEAK UP: pitch stronger stagings, new styles you've seen working, better hooks.

  We want a director's eye, not a button-pusher. Ideas that ship earn bonuses.



WHAT YOU WON'T DO

- Write scripts or music, build the final edit, or run ads. You are the production engine which turns ideas into real video.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You have real hours in at least two of: Veo, Seedance, Kling, Runway, Pika, Hailuo —

  and you understand reference images, character consistency, and style control

- You can look at any ad on
 and tell us how you'd rebuild it with AI

- You have an obsessive eye — you notice a half-second-short clip, a changed shoe color,

  a mouth moving that shouldn't

- You follow written checklists exactly, and flag problems instead of hiding them

- Comfortable with US-market direct-response health/supplement content

- Bonus: CapCut/Premiere basics, storyboarding, motion design



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, we reject 90% of applications on this alone

1. The FIRST WORD of your application must be BLUEBERRY. Applications that don't start

   with it are deleted unread.

2. Links to 3 AI clips YOU generated — in at least TWO different styles (e.g. one

   photoreal, one animated or explainer). Tell us which tool made each one.

3. Answer in 2–3 sentences: "You must generate the same character across 40 different

   shots — photoreal OR animated. How do you keep them looking identical in every shot?"

   (There is a right answer. If you know it, you'll get an interview.)

4. Tell us: your available hours + timezone, your expected hourly rate, and how soon

   you can start.



Shortlisted applicants get a 15-minute interview with a quick question: one prompt card, three generated takes —

tell us which passes and every reason the other two fail. Pass the test, get the job.

Portfolios matter less than your eye.



Long-term seat. We're building an ad factory across every format — the person who

masters this grows into leading it with huge benefits.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator



ROLE SUMMARY



This is a highly focused, part-time content creation and social media management role supporting two distinct brands:



1. A travel-focused YouTube channel

2. The Instagram account for a new podcast brand



The primary skill needed for this role is strong video editing and content creation, particularly for YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content.



The ideal candidate should also have strong visual judgment, understand social media content strategy, and be able to adapt their creative approach to two very different brands.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. Administrative work,
 management, unrelated social media accounts, and other business tasks are outside the scope of this position.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Starting rate: $5 USD per hour



Maximum: 8 hours per week



There is a hard weekly cap of 8 hours unless additional hours are approved in advance.



There is potential to increase the rate to $6-$7 per hour for a candidate who demonstrates exceptional editing, content judgment, and brand execution through the paid test and actual work.



This is a part-time, ongoing opportunity based on performance.



The candidate must accurately track their working time and work efficiently within the allotted weekly hours.



TOOLS AND ACCESS



The business will provide:



* SocialPilot access

* Canva access, if needed

* Approved brand materials and brand guidelines

* Access to source content and footage

* YouTube Studio access at the appropriate manager permission level



The contractor must provide their own video editing tools and software, such as CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform.



The contractor is responsible for maintaining their own computer, reliable internet connection, editing software, and any other equipment necessary to perform the role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 1: TRAVEL YOUTUBE CHANNEL



CONTENT STRATEGY



Before beginning regular content production, develop a proposed YouTube content strategy based on:



* Existing travel footage

* Available long-form videos

* Previous trips and destinations

* Target audience

* Channel positioning

* Opportunities for Shorts

* Opportunities for long-form content

* YouTube Community content

* Relevant content themes and recurring series

* Recommended posting cadence

* Opportunities to repurpose existing content



The strategy should identify what content should be created first and explain why.



Regular content production should not begin until the initial strategy has been reviewed and approved.



YOUTUBE SHORTS



Review existing travel footage and identify moments with strong potential for short-form content.



Responsibilities include:



* Selecting strong clips or stories

* Developing hooks

* Editing high-retention YouTube Shorts

* Adding appropriate text, captions, transitions, music, graphics, and visual elements

* Maintaining good pacing

* Writing titles and descriptions

* Recommending appropriate calls to action

* Scheduling approved content through SocialPilot



Content should feel intentional and platform-native rather than overly templated.



LONG-FORM YOUTUBE CONTENT



Create or repurpose long-form YouTube content from available source material, including:



* Travel footage

* Existing YouTube videos

* Recorded meetings

* Webinars

* Presentations

* Educational content

* Other approved recordings



Responsibilities may include:



* Identifying the strongest content

* Structuring the story or educational narrative

* Removing unnecessary portions

* Improving pacing

* Adding B-roll where appropriate

* Adding text or graphics

* Creating clean transitions

* Adding intros and outros when appropriate

* Creating or recommending thumbnails

* Writing titles and descriptions



YOUTUBE COMMUNITY



Create and publish YouTube Community content such as:



* Questions

* Polls

* Travel photos

* Conversation starters

* Travel recommendations

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Promotional posts tied to new videos



YOUTUBE ENGAGEMENT



Monitor routine audience engagement and:



* Respond to appropriate comments in the established brand voice

* Like or acknowledge relevant comments

* Identify useful audience questions

* Flag sensitive, unusual, negative, partnership, sales, or business-related inquiries for review



The contractor should not make commitments on behalf of the business without approval.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 2: PODCAST INSTAGRAM



The podcast has a separate editor who will edit full podcast episodes and produce video clips.



This role is not responsible for editing full podcast episodes from raw footage.



Instead, this person will take approved podcast clips and package them appropriately for Instagram.



PODCAST REELS



For finished clips provided by the podcast editor:



* Create branded Reel covers

* Ensure the visual presentation follows the podcast brand guidelines

* Write compelling captions

* Add appropriate calls to action

* Schedule content through SocialPilot

* Maintain consistency across the Instagram feed



PODCAST CAROUSELS



Identify ideas from podcast clips or related episode material that can be turned into standalone educational or thought-provoking carousel posts.



Examples may include:



* Key lessons

* Quotes

* Frameworks

* Questions

* Mindset shifts

* Lists

* Episode takeaways

* Discussion-provoking ideas



Create the carousel in Canva using the approved podcast visual identity.



The candidate must be able to distinguish between the travel brand and podcast brand.



The same templates, visual style, editing approach, and tone should not simply be reused across both brands.



FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLES



The first month will function as both an onboarding period and a working trial.



WEEK 1: STRATEGY AND BRAND FAMILIARIZATION



Complete the following:



* Review the existing travel content library

* Review the travel YouTube channel

* Review the podcast brand guidelines

* Review the existing podcast Instagram presence, if applicable

* Become familiar with SocialPilot

* Become familiar with Canva templates and brand assets



Deliver a concise 30-60 day content strategy.



The Travel YouTube strategy should include:



* Recommended target audience

* 3-5 primary content pillars

* Recommended Shorts strategy

* Recommended long-form strategy

* Community post strategy

* Proposed recurring content series

* Suggested posting cadence

* At least 10 initial content ideas

* Recommended priorities based on the existing footage library



The Podcast Instagram strategy should include:



* Recommended Reel posting approach

* Recommended carousel approach

* Suggested content categories

* Recommended posting cadence

* Suggestions for maintaining a cohesive branded feed



The strategy must be approved before regular production begins.



WEEKS 2-4: CONTENT PRODUCTION



Travel YouTube:



* Create approximately 6 YouTube Shorts

* Create approximately 3 YouTube Community posts

* Create approximately 1 long-form YouTube video

* Create titles and descriptions as needed

* Create or recommend thumbnails

* Schedule approved content

* Monitor and respond to comments at least twice per week



Podcast Instagram:



* Prepare approximately 6 Instagram Reels using clips supplied by the podcast editor

* Create 6 branded Reel covers

* Create approximately 3 Instagram carousel posts

* Write captions for approved posts

* Schedule approved content through SocialPilot



END-OF-MONTH REVIEW



Provide a short 30-day performance summary that includes:



* Content published

* Views and reach

* Engagement

* Strongest-performing content

* Weakest-performing content

* Observations about hooks, topics, and editing styles

* Audience questions or recurring themes

* Recommendations for the next 30 days

* Any recommended changes to the original content strategy



The goal is not simply to publish content. The contractor should learn from content performance and use those insights to improve future content.



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE



After the initial onboarding period, the ideal contractor should be able to:



* Independently identify promising content from existing footage

* Make good editorial decisions without excessive direction

* Create polished, engaging videos

* Understand what makes a strong hook

* Maintain two clearly differentiated brands

* Follow brand guidelines

* Work efficiently within an 8-hour weekly cap

* Meet deadlines consistently

* Communicate clearly when clarification is actually needed

* Schedule content correctly

* Use analytics to improve future content

* Reduce the amount of content-production work requiring the owner's direct involvement



Creativity, judgment, attention to detail, reliability, and editing ability are more important than simply having years of virtual assistant experience.

title: Ecommerce Product Researcher & Competitor Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a highly motivated Ecommerce Product Researcher & Competitor Analyst to join our team and help us find and validate winning products as we head into Q4.



This is a high-ownership role. You’ll work directly with the Founder and Operations Lead, and your research will help determine which products we test, launch, and scale.



What you’ll do:



• Research and find potential winning ecommerce products

• Monitor TikTok, Kalodata, competitor stores, social media, and emerging trends

• Analyze competitors, market demand, saturation, pricing, ads, and creative

• Determine whether a product has realistic potential to compete and scale

• Present your strongest product opportunities and explain your reasoning

• Identify products that look promising but should actually be avoided

• Track all research, products, competitors, and decisions in Google Sheets

• Source TikTok videos, B-roll, UGC, competitor creatives, and other content for approved products

• Work closely with the Operations Lead to move products from research to launch

• Keep the product pipeline organized and always know the status of every opportunity



What we’re looking for:



• Strong research and analytical skills

• Curious and naturally driven to investigate products and trends

• Good understanding of ecommerce and online shopping behavior

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Able to work independently and take ownership

• Comfortable with direct feedback and criticism

• Persistent and able to handle many failed ideas before finding a winner

• Fast learner who can adapt to new research methods and tools

• Strong communication and documentation skills

• Available and responsive 7 days a week, especially during Q4



Ecommerce or product research experience is a plus, but we’re also open to someone who has strong research skills and the right mindset.



Compensation:



$1,000/month + possible equity.



There is potential for additional upside based on the value and results generated from the products you help identify.



This is not a traditional low-pressure 9-to-5 role. We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership, move quickly, and be part of a team that is actively scaling ecommerce brands.



How to Apply:



Please include the following in your application:



One ecommerce product you believe is a winner right now. Explain why, who is already selling it, how saturated the market is, and whether we could realistically compete.

One product that looks like a winner but you believe is actually a bad opportunity. Explain what you researched, what red flags you found, and why you rejected it.

Tell us what you’re currently doing, your relevant experience, and how many hours per week you can realistically commit.



Applications without the two product analyses will not be reviewed.



If you love researching products, analyzing competitors, finding opportunities, and figuring out what can actually make money, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Turo Operations Assistant
description:
We are looking for an exceptional, highly organized Virtual Turo Operations Assistant to help manage the daily operations of our Turo fleet.



This is not simply a customer-service position. You will become an important part of our guest experience.



Our goal is simple: make renting a vehicle from us feel easy, personal, organized, thoughtful, and exceptional.



The owner and local team will handle the physical aspects of preparing, delivering, retrieving, inspecting, and maintaining vehicles. You will own the digital side of the guest journey.



Primary Responsibilities

Turo Trip Management

Monitor upcoming reservations throughout your shift.

Review new bookings and trip changes.

Respond promptly to guest messages.

Upload pre-trip and post-trip photographs provided by the local team.

Assist with Turo check-in and checkout procedures.

Send vehicle location and parking instructions.

Monitor trip start and end times.

Process appropriate trip-change requests.

Monitor extensions and late returns.

Submit eligible reimbursement requests.

Maintain accurate trip information.

Escalate potential damage, accidents, disputes, or unusual situations immediately.

Guest Experience

Every guest should feel that a real person is taking care of them. Communication should always be warm, helpful, professional, confident, clear, and personal. We never want guests to feel like they are communicating with a robotic call center.



Daily Operations

Review today's departures and returns, and tomorrow's departures.

Confirm required information has been received from the local team.

Identify missing photos or information BEFORE a guest needs it.

Monitor unresolved guest conversations.

Flag potential problems early.

Keep management informed of anything requiring attention.



What Success Looks Like

A successful VA doesn't simply wait for instructions. They are constantly asking:

What does this guest need next?

What could become a problem later?

Is anything missing?

Can I solve this without requiring the owner to stop what she is doing?

The goal is for the owner to open Turo as little as possible because the operation is already being handled exceptionally well.



Decision-Making Authority

You are encouraged to handle normal daily operations independently according to our procedures. However, immediately escalate:

Vehicle accidents, damage, or major mechanical problems.

Safety concerns or police involvement.

Threatening or abusive guests.

Suspected fraud or vehicle theft.

Guest requests for significant refunds or credits.

Situations that could create substantial financial loss.

Situations not covered by our procedures.

When you're uncertain, ask. Never guess when money, safety, vehicle damage, or Turo policy is involved.



Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

Has excellent written English and communicates naturally with American customers.

Is extremely organized and notices small details.

Can manage multiple reservations simultaneously.

Learns technology quickly and has strong judgment.

Can work independently and is comfortable taking responsibility.

Remains calm with frustrated customers.

Understands the importance of protecting guest privacy.

Has reliable high-speed internet, a reliable smartphone, and a computer.

Is comfortable working hours that overlap Arizona business hours.

Experience with Turo, vehicle rentals, hospitality, Airbnb, executive assistance, or customer-service operations is strongly preferred.



Position Details & Compensation

This is a direct-hire, remote position based in the Philippines, with hours overlapping Arizona business hours.

Employment: Direct hire, full-time, remote (Philippines).

Compensation: $7.00 USD/hour.

Schedule: 40 hours/week, with hours overlapping Arizona business hours.



Our Standard

We aren't trying to provide an average rental-car experience. We want guests to remember how well they were taken care of.

Small details matter. Fast communication matters. Clean vehicles matter.

Accurate instructions matter. How we make people feel matters.

That is what going the extra mile means.

title: Static Designer — DTC / eCommerce Ads
description:
KLIK is a DTC ecommerce brand built around the KLIK Camera — a screen-free digital camera designed to bring back the feel of 90s film photography without the film rolls. No preview screen, no camera roll. You shoot, stay present, and transfer photos via USB-C later. 4 built-in film-emulation filters, 500 shots per charge, 95g, available in 7 colors.



Rated 4.8/5 across nearly 1,000 customer reviews, sold globally at 
. The brand targets people who want to disconnect from screens and capture real moments — trips, parties, weddings, festivals, everyday life.



You can check out our account

About the Role

This is a design-first role. We need someone with a genuinely strong eye and a portfolio that proves it — static ads, campaign concepts, content that stops the scroll. Social media management is part of the role, but it's light: about one day a week, running our channels and keeping content moving. You don't need an SMM background to apply — you just need to be excited to take that piece on and make it work.



You think in concepts, not just single assets. Your camera roll is 60% screenshots, your saved folders are actually organized, and you can find a reference for anything in under two minutes. You care about the difference between clever and cute, and you have taste — the kind that's hard to teach.



What you'll do

Design (core focus)

Build shoot day briefs — shot lists, moodboards, references, prop and styling notes

Own our social channels — content calendar, posting cadence, and platform strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and beyond

Write clear, inspiring UGC briefs and review creator output

Manage our community — DMs, comments, creator relationships

Spot trends before they peak and bring them into our content



What we're looking for

A strong, proven design portfolio — this is the priority. We're looking for real static ad work, campaign concepts, or content design we can look at, not just okay-looking posts

A strong eye for D2C, lifestyle, and creator-driven brands

You think in campaigns and systems, not just one-off assets

description:

Your job is to take the article/topic and footage we provide and turn it into a compelling Instagram Reel.



For each Reel, you will:



* Identify the most compelling angle for Instagram based on the source material we provide

* Write a strong opening hook / on-screen text

* Select the best clips and/or photos from the material provided

* Edit the Reel with strong pacing and retention in mind

* Add appropriate on-screen text, captions and transitions

* Select suitable music/audio where appropriate

* Stay up to date with current Instagram Reel trends, formats, editing styles and best practices

* Adapt future content based on what performs well



We are specifically outsourcing this because we focus on writing and do not want to spend our own time researching Instagram trends, so you should be someone who naturally keeps up with what is currently working on the platform.



Our ideal candidate should have:



* Strong experience creating Instagram Reels or other short-form social video

* A good understanding of hooks, retention and short-form storytelling

* The ability to turn informational content into something people actually want to watch

* Strong English, especially for concise and natural on-screen text

* Good judgment when choosing footage and structuring a Reel

* An understanding of current Instagram trends without relying on generic or outdated formulas



Experience creating content for any of the following is a major plus:



* Travel companies

* Tourism brands

* Hotels or hospitality businesses

* Travel creators or publishers

* Lifestyle brands



You do **not** need to be an expert on the destinations themselves. We will provide the factual information.



We are initially looking for approximately 8–12 Reels per month.



Budget:



**$250–$350 USD per month**, depending on your experience, portfolio and proposed number of Reels.



This is intended to be an ongoing role if we work well together, with an opportunity to increase the scope, number of Reels and compensation as we grow.



You will be working with original photos, videos and other materials that belong to our business.



These materials may not be:



* Shared with other clients or third parties

* Reused for another project

* Published in your portfolio without permission

* Uploaded to AI tools without permission

* Sold, redistributed or used outside our project



Please also let us know if you currently create content for competing travel publishers.



HOW TO APPLY 



Please include:

2. Three Instagram Reels you personally created or edited

   * Caption

6. A brief explanation of how you stay current with Instagram trends, Reel formats, hooks, editing styles and what is currently performing well



7. Please complete this short sample exercise:



Imagine we give you an existing travel article titled **“Disneyland Paris for Toddlers”** along with original photos and video clips from the visit.

title: Amazon FBA Admin VA — Cost Tracking, Reimbursements & Reconciliation
description:
About the role:

We're a growing Amazon FBA retail arbitrage business looking for a detail-focused admin VA to keep our back-office numbers accurate. This is not a sourcing/product research role — no Keepa charts, no product hunting. This is entirely about accuracy, reconciliation, and follow-through on financial details that directly affect our profit.



What you'll do:



Cost price entry & reconciliation — Enter accurate cost-of-goods data into our spreadsheet for every purchase, making sure it reflects the true price paid after discounts, promos, and gift cards (not face value). This number feeds our profit calculations directly, so precision matters.

Gift card tracking — Monitor gift card balances through our tracking tool to make sure balances are fully used down to $0, flagging any card with leftover funds.

Shipment monitoring — Track outgoing packages/shipments, confirm delivery status, and check in proactively if something looks delayed or missing. This part of the role rewards patience — some weeks are quiet, others have five things going wrong at once, and staying calm through both matters more than speed. When you apply, open your message with your favorite comfort food, so I know you made it this far.

Inbox monitoring — Watch our purchase inbox for receipts and order confirmations, and log the correct cost data into the spreadsheet from each one.

Reimbursement claims — When Amazon loses or misplaces inventory during check-in, locate the original purchase receipt, and write and submit a reimbursement case to Amazon (documenting units sent, units received, and requesting reimbursement). Follow up until it's resolved — these often get rejected once and need resubmitting.

Cost of Goods (COG) uploads in Seller Central — Keep COG data current in Seller Central so that if Amazon loses or damages inventory, the reimbursement Amazon calculates is based on accurate numbers (not underpaying us because the data on file is stale).



What we need:



Excellent attention to detail — this role is almost entirely numbers, and small errors cost real money

Comfortable in Google Sheets

Strong written English (you'll be writing reimbursement cases directly to Amazon)

Bookkeeping or data-entry experience preferred — you should be comfortable reconciling numbers, not just copying them

Persistent — Amazon claims often get denied the first time and need to be resubmitted with more documentation

Follows a process consistently, and flags anything that looks off instead of guessing



Nice to have (not required — happy to train):



Experience with FBA shipment discrepancies or reimbursement claims

Familiarity with Seller Central

Prior e-commerce bookkeeping experience



To apply: Tell us a bit about your relevant experience and availability.
