title: Senior SEO & GEO Specialist – Help Us Scale 40+ Clients
description:
# Senior SEO & GEO Specialist



**Remote | Philippines | 10–15 hours/week | $15–25/hour | Long-term opportunity**



We are looking for an experienced **Senior SEO & GEO Specialist** to become the technical and strategic SEO expert behind our growing client portfolio.



We currently manage SEO for approximately **35–40 Danish businesses** and want to significantly grow our SEO MRR while maintaining — and improving — the quality of our work and client retention.



This is **not a junior SEO role**.



We are willing to pay up to **$25/hour for someone who is genuinely excellent**.



We prefer 15 hours from an outstanding SEO specialist over 40 hours from an average one.



## About the Role



Your primary responsibility will be the **actual SEO and GEO work behind our client portfolio**.



You will not primarily be responsible for customer communication.



We already have a team member who manages customer communication, coordination and follow-up.



Your job is to be the **SEO expert behind the work**.



You will:



**Analyze ? Prioritize ? Execute ? Measure ? Document ? Recommend what happens next.**



We don't want someone who simply runs an Ahrefs or Semrush audit and sends us a list of 100 errors.



We want someone who can look at a website and determine:



**"What are the most important things we can do to improve this client's organic performance?"**



## SEO Strategy & Execution



You should have strong experience with:



* SEO strategy

* Keyword research

* Search intent

* SERP analysis

* Competitor analysis

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools

* On-page SEO

* Content optimization

* Content briefs

* Landing page strategy

* Internal linking

* Site architecture

* Keyword cannibalization

* Indexation

* Crawlability

* Canonicals

* Redirects

* XML sitemaps

* Robots.txt

* Schema / structured data

* Duplicate content

* Broken links

* Diagnosing ranking and traffic declines



Most importantly, you need to know how to **prioritize**.



Finding an SEO problem does not automatically mean it is worth spending time fixing.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



**"This is technically imperfect."**



and:



**"Fixing this is likely to have a meaningful impact."**



## Technical SEO & Website Performance



You will NOT be responsible for building websites.



However, you must be comfortable working hands-on with **existing websites and improving their technical and SEO performance**.



Website performance is an important part of this role.



You should be comfortable investigating and improving:



* Core Web Vitals

* Google PageSpeed Insights

* Lighthouse

* LCP

* INP

* CLS

* Website loading speed

* Mobile performance

* Image optimization

* Image compression

* WebP / AVIF

* Lazy loading

* Caching

* CDN configuration

* WordPress performance

* Plugin performance

* Fonts

* CSS and JavaScript optimization

* Render-blocking resources

* Third-party scripts

* Server response issues

* JavaScript-related SEO issues



We don't want someone who simply tells us:



**"The website is slow."**



We want someone who investigates **why** it is slow and improves the things that can reasonably be improved on the existing website.



For example, if a WordPress website has poor Core Web Vitals because of oversized images, unnecessary plugins, caching configuration or render-blocking resources, you should be comfortable investigating and improving these issues.



You are NOT expected to be a full-stack developer.



If something genuinely requires development work, you should be able to clearly document:



**What is wrong ? Why it matters ? What needs to change ? How we verify the fix afterwards.**



You should then verify that the developer's solution actually fixed the problem.



The goal is:



**Make our clients' existing websites perform better — technically, in search engines and for users.**



## GEO / AI Search



We want GEO / AI Search to become a natural part of our SEO offering.



You should therefore be actively interested in and working with:



* GEO / Generative Engine Optimization

* AI Search

* AI Overviews

* LLM visibility

* Entity and brand signals

* Brand mentions and citations

* Structured data

* Topical authority

* Content structure for AI discovery

* Clear question/answer content

* Original and first-party information

* Authority and trust signals

* How traditional SEO influences AI visibility

* Measuring and monitoring AI visibility where reasonably possible



We do NOT expect you to claim that you have completely "solved GEO."



This area is developing quickly.



We prefer someone who tests, learns and thinks critically.



We want you to understand:



**What appears to actually work — and what is just GEO hype.**



## Link Building & Authority



We also want to develop our authority/link-building offering.



You should understand:



* Backlink analysis

* Competitor backlink analysis

* Link gaps

* Relevance

* Authority

* Anchor text

* Toxic/spammy links

* Link quality

* Authority gaps



You should be able to identify when link building could genuinely help a client.



But you should also be comfortable saying:



**"Links are not the priority for this client right now."**



We are not interested in hundreds of cheap, low-quality backlinks.



Quality, relevance and business impact matter.



## Client Retention



We currently manage approximately **35–40 SEO clients** and intend to grow.



Keeping our existing clients is just as important as acquiring new ones.



Part of your responsibility will therefore be helping us identify clients that require attention before they become dissatisfied.



We want to gradually classify accounts based on things such as:



**Healthy**

Performance and work are developing as expected.



**Attention**

Performance is stagnating or there are issues/opportunities requiring attention.



**Risk**

There is a significant decline, technical problem or other concern.



**Opportunity**

There is a clear opportunity for additional organic growth.



We want to become increasingly proactive.



If a client's organic traffic suddenly starts declining, we want to know and investigate **before the client asks us why**.



## Identify Growth Opportunities



We also want you to identify opportunities that can create additional value for our clients.



This could include:



* Link building

* Authority improvements

* Additional landing pages

* Content opportunities

* GEO opportunities

* Technical improvements

* Competitor gaps

* Content gaps

* New keyword opportunities



You will not primarily be responsible for selling these services.



Your responsibility is to identify and explain the **business and SEO opportunity**.



Our customer-facing team can then discuss it with the client.



## Documentation Is Essential



This is extremely important.



Our customer coordinator needs to understand what has been done so that the work can be communicated clearly to the client.



After working on a client, you should document:



### WHAT DID YOU FIND?



What did your analysis show?



### WHAT DID YOU DO?



What did you actually change or implement?



### WHY?



Why was this work prioritized?



### RESULT / MONITORING



What happened, or what should we monitor going forward?



### NEXT ACTION



What should happen next?



We never want a situation where someone asks:



**"What did we actually do for this client this month?"**



and nobody can answer clearly.



## Working With Our Customer Coordinator



You will work alongside an existing team member who is responsible for customer communication and coordination.



The ideal workflow is:



**You identify and execute the SEO/GEO work**



?



**You document what was done and why**



?



**Our coordinator communicates clearly with the client**



?



**You continue monitoring performance and determining the next priorities**



This allows you to spend the majority of your time on SEO rather than customer service.



## Help Us Build a Scalable SEO Operation



We are not only hiring you to complete tasks.



We also want your expertise to help us improve **how we deliver SEO across the entire portfolio**.



Over time, we want your input on:



* What should happen when a new SEO client starts?

* What should we check every month?

* What should we check quarterly?

* How should we monitor 40+ clients efficiently?

* How do we identify clients at risk?

* How should we prioritize work?

* How should SEO work be documented?

* How should GEO be incorporated into our product?

* How should we identify growth opportunities?

* What should be standardized?

* What can be automated?

* What requires senior expertise?

* What can be delegated to other team members?



We want to build a system that can support significantly more clients **without sacrificing quality**.



## Danish Websites



Our clients are primarily Danish businesses.



The websites, keywords, Search Console queries, content and other information you work with will therefore often be in **Danish**.



You do NOT need to speak Danish.



Our internal communication with you will be in **English**.



You should be comfortable using tools such as **ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools** to translate and understand Danish content independently.



However, simply translating a keyword from English to Danish is not SEO research.



You still need to use:



* SERP analysis

* Search Console

* Keyword data

* Competitors

* Search intent

* Actual search behavior



to determine what Danish users are searching for.



Language should not prevent you from doing excellent SEO.



## AI Is Part of the Workflow



You should be highly comfortable using modern AI tools.



We encourage the intelligent use of AI for:



* Research

* Translation

* Data analysis

* Content analysis

* Content briefs

* Identifying patterns

* Documentation

* SOP creation

* Workflow improvements

* Brainstorming

* Scaling repetitive parts of SEO



But we are NOT looking for someone who generates generic AI content and calls it SEO.



**AI should make your SEO expertise more productive — not replace your SEO expertise.**



## Who We Are Looking For



You are:



* A genuinely experienced SEO specialist

* Strong in technical SEO

* Strong in on-page SEO

* Strong with Google Search Console

* Comfortable improving existing website performance

* Analytical

* Commercially aware

* Excellent at prioritizing

* Comfortable working hands-on

* Curious about GEO and AI Search

* Knowledgeable about authority and link building

* Comfortable challenging assumptions

* Proactive

* Good at documenting your work

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to explain complex SEO issues simply

* Interested in improving systems and processes



Most importantly:



**You think like an SEO specialist, not an SEO checklist.**



## Hours & Compensation



We are initially looking for:



**10–15 hours per week**



Compensation:



**$15–25 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.**



We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who is genuinely excellent.



We prefer:



**15 hours from an excellent specialist**



over



**40 hours from an average specialist.**



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As our SEO portfolio grows, there may be opportunities for additional hours and responsibility.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**"SEO is about priorities."**



Applications that do not start with these words will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your CV/resume.

3. How many years you have worked professionally with SEO.

4. Your strongest SEO skills.

5. Your experience with technical SEO.

6. Examples of website performance/Core Web Vitals improvements you have personally implemented.

7. Your experience with Google Search Console.

8. Your experience with Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools.

9. Your experience with link building and authority.

10. Your experience with GEO / AI Search.

11. How you currently use AI in your SEO work.

12. Your expected hourly rate.

13. Your weekly availability.



## Please Answer These Questions



**1. A website loses 30% of its organic clicks over three months. What are the first things you investigate, and why?**



**2. A client's website has poor Core Web Vitals. PageSpeed shows multiple problems. Walk us through how you d
 what actually needs to be fixed and what you would personally implement.**



**3. You only have two hours available for a client this month. How do you d
 what to work on?**



**4. A competitor has significantly more backlinks than our client. Does that automatically mean we should build links? Explain your thinking.**



**5. What do you currently believe is genuinely important for GEO / AI Search visibility — and what do you think is mostly hype?**



**6. Tell us about an SEO recommendation you deliberately chose NOT to implement because something else was more important.**



## Paid Practical Test



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical SEO test**.



You will receive a real website and realistic data.



We will ask you to analyze the situation and tell us:



* What you found

* What concerns you

* What opportunities you see

* What you would prioritize

* What you would NOT spend time on

* What you would personally implement

* What requires a developer

* What you would do over the next 90 days

* Why



We are NOT interested in who can produce the longest SEO audit.



We are interested in who can identify:



**What actually matters.**



If you are an experienced SEO specialist who enjoys solving difficult problems, improving websites, working with data and helping build a scalable SEO operation, we would like to hear from you.

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor — Meta/TikTok Ads
description:

I create high-volume UGC ads for brands, primarily in men’s fashion, eyewear, fitness, grooming, and lifestyle. I’m looking for someone who can take my raw footage and turn it into clean, high-performing Meta, Instagram, and TikTok ads.



Your main job:



I film. You edit.



I want to be able to send you batches of raw footage and instructions, and have you turn them into finished ads without me spending hours editing them myself.



What you’ll be doing:



* Editing 9:16 short-form UGC videos, usually 15–60 seconds

* Cutting pauses, mistakes, and dead space

* Creating natural, fast-paced jump cuts

* Adding clean, easy-to-read captions

* Adding text, B-roll, product shots, music, and sound effects when appropriate

* Following reference ads and examples I provide

* Editing multiple hook variations from similar footage

* Organizing and naming finished files correctly

* Making revisions when needed

* Learning my editing style so less direction is needed over time



These are direct-response social media ads — not cinematic videos. I care much more about strong hooks, pacing, retention, and making the content feel native to TikTok/Instagram than flashy transitions or unnecessary effects.



You can use CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or another professional editing program. I care about the finished product, not which software you use.



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, or paid social ads

* Has excellent English comprehension

* Understands short-form pacing and viewer retention

* Can follow instructions and reference videos closely

* Is organized and reliable

* Communicates well

* Can handle batches of videos efficiently

* Wants a long-term position with the opportunity to grow as my business grows



UGC/direct-response advertising experience is a major plus.



HOW TO APPLY:



Start your application with the word SUNGLASSES so I know you read the entire posting.



Then answer these questions:



1. Send links to the 3 videos you’ve edited that are most similar to UGC/TikTok/Meta ads. Please don’t send only a general portfolio.

2. What editing software do you use?

3. Have you edited UGC or paid social advertisements before?

5. What’s your normal turnaround time for a batch of 10 videos?

7. What rate are you looking for?

title: Head of Marketplace (Amazon Sales)
description:
Truegenics Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based e-commerce company with a track record of more than US$218 million in online product sales. We develop and market our own brands of health supplements and beauty products to customers around the world.



As we continue to grow our Amazon business, we are looking for a commercially strong and hands-on Head of Marketplace for Amazon Sales to take ownership of the channel across our portfolio of brands.



Mission of the Role: The Head of Marketplace for Amazon Sales will be responsible for independently running and growing Truegenics’ Amazon business. You will own Amazon channel performance across revenue, profitability, advertising, marketplace execution, product launches, inventory health and day-to-day commercial decision-making.



This is a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who can set direction, identify what is driving or limiting performance, make sound commercial decisions and personally step into the details when required. Success will be measured by the ability to grow Amazon profitably, solve problems proactively and build a more scalable and effective Amazon operation.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon P&L & Growth

- Own Amazon revenue, profitability, advertising efficiency, pricing, promotions and overall channel performance across multiple brands

- Develop growth plans, forecasts and targets and identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve revenue and profitability.

- Regularly assess performance and make clear recommendations on where to invest, optimise or change direction.



Advertising & Marketplace Performance

- Own Amazon PPC and advertising performance, including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and overall advertising profitability.

- Improve organic rankings, traffic and conversion through keyword strategy, listing optimisation, content, pricing, promotions and reviews.

- Maintain strong account and marketplace health and resolve material Seller Central, listing, compliance or operational issues.



Product & Portfolio Growth

- Lead Amazon launches for new products and brands, including keyword strategy, advertising, inventory, pricing, reviews and ranking.

- Monitor ASIN-level performance and identify which products should be scaled, improved, repositioned or deprioritised.

- Stay close to category, competitor and marketplace developments and translate these into commercial actions.



Inventory & Commercial Planning

- Work closely with Supply Chain and Finance to align sales forecasts, inventory purchasing and FBA requirements.

- Maintain healthy stock availability while managing inventory turns, excess inventory, storage costs and cash-flow considerations.

- Anticipate inventory requirements arising from growth, promotions, launches and seasonality.



Team, Systems & Reporting

- Lead the small Amazon team and manage external agencies or specialist partners where appropriate.

- Set clear priorities, KPIs and accountability for the resources supporting Amazon.

- Build practical SOPs, dashboards and operating processes that improve consistency and allow the channel to scale.

- Provide management with concise reporting that explains what happened, why it happened and what actions should be taken next.

- Use AI, automation and technology to improve productivity, accelerate analysis and decision-making, and continuously improve Amazon performance and operating efficiency. 



Key Requirements

- 5–8 years of relevant e-commerce, marketplace or digital commerce experience, with meaningful responsibility for Amazon.

- At least 3 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience, preferably within the US marketplace.

- Proven ability to grow Amazon revenue and improve commercial performance.

- Experience managing or materially influencing Amazon P&L, including revenue, margins, advertising spend, pricing and forecasting.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon PPC, ACOS/TACOS, keyword strategy, rankings, listing optimisation and conversion.

- Good understanding of Amazon FBA, inventory planning and marketplace operations.

- Experience managing multiple products and/or brands.

- Strong analytical ability and comfort working with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards and performance data.

- Commercially minded and able to balance growth, profitability, inventory and cash-flow considerations.

- Hands-on, proactive and comfortable solving problems without waiting for detailed direction.

- Able to lead a small team and work effectively across Supply Chain, Finance, Creative and other internal functions.



Experience in supplements, health, beauty or other competitive consumer categories would be advantageous.



The Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate operates like the owner of the Amazon channel.



When performance changes, you do not simply report the numbers. You investigate what caused the change and determine whether the issue is advertising, conversion, ranking, pricing, inventory, competition or the product itself.



You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You can build a growth plan, review channel profitability, challenge an agency, analyse an underperforming product and go directly into Seller Central when required.



You actively use AI, automation and technology to work smarter, move faster and improve performance, while applying sound commercial judgment to the outputs. 



You do not need a large team or extensive layers of support to get things done. You are resourceful, commercially sharp and comfortable making decisions in a fast-moving environment.



Most importantly, you take ownership. You see yourself as accountable for growing the Amazon business profitably and not simply managing the activities around it.



Why Join Us



This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an important growth channel within an established international e-commerce company.



You will have the autonomy to shape how we grow Amazon, influence product and investment decisions, improve the way the channel operates and build a stronger Amazon business across multiple Truegenics brands.



Note: The role will initially be offered on a 6-month contract, with the opportunity for permanent employment subject to successful performance.

title: Senior C# / .NET Developer (Windows Services + REST API Integration) for Healthcare Booking Platform
description:

We are an Australian company building an online appointment booking product for healthcare practices. Patients book on a branded web page, the appointment writes directly into the practice's existing practice management software in real time, and a confirmation event (never patient data) is sent to our analytics service. Part of the web layer already exists in production. You will build the integration layer.

Idempotency and concurrency handling: a retried request must never create two appointments, and two patients must never take the same slot

A webhook posting confirmed-booking events to our analytics service

Fleet tooling: auto-update pipeline, health monitoring, alerts



Requirements:



Strong C# / .NET including Windows services, not only web APIs

You have shipped software that runs unattended on customers' machines: installers, self-update, and diagnosing faults you cannot reproduce locally

REST and OData integration against third-party APIs you do not control

Queuing, retry and idempotency patterns

Careful work against live production databases you must not corrupt

Good written English and at least 4 hours daily overlap with Sydney time

Nice to have: healthcare, dental or veterinary software integration; Azure



How we will hire:



NDA first, then a small paid trial task, then full-time engagement

Long-term role for the right person

All work is IP-assigned to our company

We work in a code-named brief; real system names are shared after NDA only



Answer these three in your application:



Describe something you built that runs on a customer's machine. How did it update itself, and how did you diagnose a fault you could not reproduce?

A booking API call times out and you do not know whether the appointment was created. What exactly does your design do next?

A returning patient types their name slightly differently from the database record. How does your matching d
, and what happens when it is not confident?

description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)

- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.

COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Base: $1,000

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Show Rate: 90%+

---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.

- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---

Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)

nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to join our accounting practice.

This is a senior, hands-on role suited to an accountant who can take ownership of client work from start to finish, review work prepared by bookkeepers and junior accountants, and provide guidance and training to team members.

The successful candidate will be technically capable, organised and confident working independently. You will be expected to manage your own workload, identify and resolve issues, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality work without requiring ongoing supervision or step-by-step direction.



You will work closely with the Director and Client Managers while also acting as a senior point of support for our bookkeeping and accounting team.



Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Tax Compliance

• Manage accounting and tax compliance work for a portfolio of clients from commencement through to completion.

• Prepare and review annual financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets and supporting workpapers.

• Prepare and review company, trust, partnership and individual income tax returns.

• Prepare and review BAS and IAS lodgements and other ATO compliance obligations.

• Review general ledgers, reconciliations and bookkeeping records and identify errors, inconsistencies and areas requiring further investigation.

• Perform tax reconciliations and ensure accounting records are appropriately prepared for year-end compliance.

• Identify relevant tax issues and make appropriate adjustments or recommendations.

• Ensure work is completed accurately and in accordance with Australian taxation requirements, accounting principles and internal practice standards.

• Manage assigned jobs and lodgement deadlines proactively.

Review & Quality Control

• Review work prepared by bookkeepers and junior accountants before submission for final review or lodgement.

• Identify errors and provide clear review notes explaining what needs to be corrected and why.

• Ensure workpapers and supporting documentation are complete, accurate and appropriately documented.

• Identify recurring issues in team members' work and provide practical guidance to improve future performance.

• Maintain a high standard of accuracy and consistency across client files.

Team Guidance & Development

• Provide day-to-day technical guidance to bookkeepers and junior accountants.

• Train and mentor team members in bookkeeping, reconciliations, BAS preparation, year-end accounts and tax compliance processes.

• Assist team members in developing stronger problem-solving and technical accounting skills.

• Delegate appropriate tasks and follow up to ensure work is completed correctly and on time.

• Help establish efficient and consistent processes across the accounting team.



About You

To succeed in this role, you will be someone who can be given responsibility for a job and take ownership of getting it 

completed correctly and on time.

You will be comfortable reviewing the work of others, identifying issues and providing constructive guidance to less experienced team members.

You will ideally have:

• Strong experience in Australian public practice accounting.

• Strong knowledge of Australian taxation, GST, BAS and general accounting requirements.

• Experience preparing financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships and individuals.

• Demonstrated experience reviewing accounting, bookkeeping and tax compliance work prepared by other team members.

• Experience supervising, training or mentoring bookkeepers and/or junior accountants.

• Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify issues rather than simply process information.

• Strong organisational and time-management skills.

• The ability to manage multiple client jobs and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• A proactive approach and the ability to work with minimal supervision.



Qualifications & Experience

• Relevant accounting qualification.

• CPA or CA qualification, or progress towards qualification, will be highly regarded.

• Minimum 2-3 years' relevant accounting experience, within an Australian public practice environment.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian tax compliance and financial statement preparation.

• Experience reviewing the work of junior staff is strongly preferred.

• Experience with accounting and practice management software such as Xero, MYOB and/or similar platforms will be highly regarded.



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think through a job, identify what needs to be done, investigate discrepancies, resolve routine issues and present a substantially completed file for final review.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
Senior SEO Specialist



Full-Time | Remote | Recruiting in the Philippines



HOW TO APPLY



If this sounds like you, please submit:



* Your current CV

* Five URL examples of websites you have personally optimised within the last 24 months



For each of the five websites, please specify:



* When you worked on the website — month/year to month/year

* The duration of your involvement

* Your role and the SEO work you personally completed

* Any measurable results achieved, where available



Please also provide:



* Clear case studies or proof of measurable SEO results

* Evidence of traffic growth that generated leads or sales

* A short introduction explaining why you are the right person for this role



The five website examples are an important part of our initial review and will help us assess the depth, recency and practical impact of your hands-on SEO experience.



Please only provide websites where you were personally involved in the SEO work. We are interested in seeing examples that demonstrate your ability to independently develop and execute SEO strategies and achieve measurable results.



If you have not heard back within 10 days of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful for progression to the next stage.



ABOUT US



We are an Australian-based, award-winning digital marketing agency specialising in PPC (Google Ads & Meta Ads) and CRO (Conversion Rate Optimisation).



Everything we do is built around two clear goals:



1. Help our clients generate more sales through smart, performance-driven marketing.



We use strategic paid media and conversion optimisation to drive measurable, scalable growth.



2. Produce award-level work that delivers real commercial impact.



From paid campaigns to organic search, our standard is simple — drive growth and create work we’re proud to win awards for.



We work across a wide range of industries including insurance, e-commerce, pizza franchises, florists, childcare centres, restaurants, trailers, containers, luxury accommodation, yachts, coaching businesses and more.



Although we are based in Australia, this is a full-time remote position being recruited in the Philippines.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a Senior SEO Specialist with 5+ years of experience and a proven track record of delivering measurable organic growth that translates into real revenue.



This is not a role for someone who focuses on rankings alone.



We are looking for someone who understands that:



* Rankings without traffic are meaningless

* Traffic without conversions is vanity

* SEO must generate measurable ROI



You will be accountable not just for ranking commercial keywords, but for driving qualified visitors and proving that the traffic generated produces leads and/or e-commerce sales.



If Google Ads dominates certain search results, you must know how to identify opportunities where organic traffic can still win and produce measurable commercial impact.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means:



* Identifying revenue-driving keyword opportunities

* Increasing qualified organic traffic

* Improving rankings where real search demand exists

* Demonstrating measurable ROI from SEO efforts

* Contributing to increased leads and/or e-commerce revenue



We measure success by impact — not activity.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will take full ownership of SEO strategy and implementation across our client portfolio.



ON-PAGE SEO & REVENUE-FOCUSED CONTENT



* Conduct advanced keyword research focused on sales-driving intent

* Identify high-impact keywords with real traffic potential

* Avoid vanity rankings with no commercial value

* Create and optimise high-quality, conversion-focused SEO content

* Structure pages around search intent and conversion outcomes

* Build strong internal linking strategies



TECHNICAL SEO



* Conduct technical audits and resolve core issues

* Improve crawlability, indexing and site architecture

* Optimise site speed and Core Web Vitals

* Implement schema markup

* Ensure technical health supports rankings and performance



LOCAL SEO



* Google Business Profile optimisation

* Local search and map pack ranking improvements

* Local citation strategy



AI & MODERN SEARCH OPTIMISATION



* Implement AI-informed optimisation strategies

* Optimise for evolving AI-assisted search environments

* Leverage AI tools responsibly to enhance productivity and results

* Ensure social and content ecosystems support organic performance



You must be able to both develop strategy and execute implementation yourself.



We are not looking for someone who proposes ideas and blames others if results are not achieved. We are looking for someone who takes ownership and proves performance.



EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIRED



* 5+ years of professional SEO experience

* Proven track record of increasing rankings and qualified organic traffic

* Clear evidence of SEO campaigns that generated measurable leads or revenue

* Strong experience in on-page SEO and content creation

* Deep understanding of technical SEO

* Experience with Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation

* Strong commercial mindset and understanding of revenue impact

* Experience using leading SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush and Screaming Frog

* Ability to independently execute both strategy and implementation

* Ability to demonstrate past campaigns where SEO generated real ROI



ACCOUNTABILITY



You will be directly responsible for:



* Increasing qualified organic traffic

* Improving rankings for commercially valuable keywords with real search volume

* Driving measurable growth in leads and/or e-commerce sales

* Proving SEO ROI through data



We do not measure success by reports.



We measure success by results.



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Is commercially minded and ROI-focused

* Has delivered proven SEO results in competitive markets

* Can show real traffic growth that led to real revenue

* Is a self-starter and works independently

* Takes ownership of outcomes

* Thrives in a performance-driven environment

* Wants to contribute to an ambitious, award-winning agency



You should want to be known for delivering exceptional SEO performance — not just activity.



WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



This role is not suitable for someone who:



* Focuses only on rankings without traffic

* Cannot prove measurable results

* Is still learning SEO fundamentals

* Relies on others to implement strategy

* Blames external factors for poor performance

* Treats remote work casually

* Is looking for a part-time or secondary income role



We are not looking for someone to “learn on our clients.”



We are looking for someone who already knows how to deliver measurable growth.



WHAT YOU’LL GAIN



* Full-time remote flexibility

* Exposure to diverse and competitive industries

* Opportunity to deliver high-level SEO within a performance-driven agency

* Work alongside PPC and CRO specialists

* A results-focused, ambitious environment

* The chance to build a reputation for measurable SEO excellence

description:
Webflow Designer (editorial, refined, minimal)



Are you a Webflow designer who leans editorial, refined and minimal rather than techy and heavy? We're a small Australian brand and website strategy business, and we're looking for a designer to support our ongoing client work.



Our work is strategy-led, clean and conversion-focused, with a strong emphasis on white space, hierarchy and restraint. This is not a role for "just build it" developers. We care about how a site feels, not only how it functions.



The kind of work we do



We design websites for service-based businesses. Think clean layouts, strong hierarchy, generous white space, refined typography, subtle interactions and elevated, considered design.



Not dark or heavy tech-style builds, over-designed layouts, or cluttered sections with excessive effects. If your portfolio leans corporate, SaaS or developer-heavy, this probably isn't the right fit.



Why you'll enjoy working with us



Clear direction. Strategy, copy and wireframes are provided. Defined scope, so no guesswork and no vague briefs. Flexible hours, working to deadlines rather than fixed shifts. Respectful collaboration with no last-minute chaos. And consistent, long-term work for the right person. We prioritise quality over speed.



What you'll be doing



Building websites in Webflow from provided strategy and wireframes. Translating brand direction into clean, high-end layouts. Structuring CMS collections logically. Applying SEO basics during the build. Refining and improving existing Webflow sites. And making sure every build is easy for clients to manage. Designing in Figma before build is a bonus, not a requirement.



What we need



Webflow: strong hands-on experience, confident with CMS, components and interactions, and clean builds only, no messy overrides or shortcuts.



Client-First: a solid understanding of the Client-First structure, with clear class naming and scalable systems.



SEO basics: proper heading structure, meta titles and descriptions, alt text and CMS SEO fields, and internal linking.



The non-negotiable



Your work needs to show strong use of white space, clean and minimal layouts, high-end service-based design and thoughtful typography. We won't consider portfolios that feel heavy, corporate or tech-driven, are cluttered or visually noisy, or prioritise effects over clarity.



Your working style



You work well independently with clear direction, you flag early if something's off, you meet deadlines, you're open to feedback, and you take real pride in clean, considered work.



Hours and rate



Part-time and ongoing, with flexible hours worked to deadlines rather than set shifts. Rate is based on experience.



How to apply



Applications are through the form below, please keep everything on this platform. You'll be asked for 2 to 4 live Webflow sites you personally built, at least one clean service-based site, an example using Client-First, a short note on how you approach SEO in Webflow, and your rate and weekly availability.



We'll only review applications from designers based in the Philippines who include the requested live examples.

title: Facebook Ads Creative Strategist (Static + Video)
description:
# Genghis Digital

## OnlineJobs.ph Job Ad:
 Ads Creative Strategist



---



## JOB TITLE (pick one)



**Primary:**

>
 Ads Creative Strategist (Static + Video, Copywriting Led)



**Alternatives:**

> Meta Ads Creative Strategist | Copy, Statics, Reels | AU Agency, Long Term

>

> Direct Response Creative Strategist for Meta Ads (Canva, Video, Copy)



*Note: OnlineJobs.ph search runs on keywords. Keep 
 Ads" or "Meta Ads" plus "Creative Strategist" in the title. Put "graphic designer" or "video editor" in there and you'll get 200 of the wrong applicants.*



---



## JOB DETAILS FIELDS



| Field | Entry |

|---|---|

| **Job Type** | Full-time (or part-time 20 hrs/week to start, see notes) |

| **Salary** | AUD $1,200 to $1,500 per month, depending on portfolio and test task |

| **Hours** | Mon to Fri, overlapping 9am to 5pm AWST (Perth runs on the same clock as Manila) |

| **Category** | Advertising / Marketing / Creative |

| **Skills** |
 Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Copywriting, Direct Response, Funnels, Canva, Reels, Shorts, Video Editing, Creative Strategy, UGC, Market Research, AI Tools, ClickUp, Hubstaff |



---



## JOB DESCRIPTION (paste this section)



### About us



Genghis Digital is a digital marketing agency based in Perth, Western Australia. We run Meta and Google Ads, build websites and CRMs, and generate leads for clients across coaching, health, trades, construction, finance and hospitality.



We're a small remote team. You'd work directly with me (Marlon, the founder), alongside our media buyer, web builder and designer.



### What this role actually is



I'll be upfront, because it saves us both time.



At the moment I'm the one doing the research, working out the angle, writing the hook and d
 what we test. I hand that over, and what comes back matches the brief but has no idea behind it, with copy that reads like it came straight out of ChatGPT. That part of my week is what I want to hand off.



So the job is this. You get a client, an offer and an ad account, and you come back with ads you can defend. Angles you picked for a reason, written in words an actual buyer would use.



If you need a finished brief in front of you before you can start, this will frustrate both of us. Better you skip it.



### What you'd own



Research. Going through the client's offer, their competitors' ads, reviews, sales call notes, form responses,
 groups, anywhere the buyer's own words show up. You come back with the objections and the language.



Angles. Working out what belief needs shifting, and for who.



**Funnel stage creative.** This is the part that matters most. A top of funnel ad, a middle of funnel ad and a bottom of funnel ad are three different jobs. Cold traffic needs a problem named and something that stops the scroll. Middle of funnel needs the mechanism, the proof and the objections handled. Bottom of funnel needs the offer, a reason to move now and the risk taken off the table. If all three come back looking much the same, we've got a problem.



Copy. Hooks, primary text, headlines, calls to action, in plain language. Single most important skill in this role.



Statics, built in Canva. They don't need to win awards. They need to stop the scroll and be readable on a phone.



**Video, also built in Canva.** Scripted, cut and captioned by you. Vertical 9:16 for Reels and Shorts is our default format. Talking head, UGC style, screen recordings, slideshows, whatever suits the angle. Our team works in Canva so files stay shared and editable, which makes Canva video skills essential here. Other editors are a bonus, not a substitute.



Reading the numbers. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per lead. Telling me what's dying and what you want to try next, before I have to ask.



Turnaround. When I flag something, it gets sorted in your next work session rather than next week.



### What a normal week looks like



It varies. Some weeks are one client and a new offer to go deep on, others are a refresh across a few accounts. What stays consistent:



- New creative across all three funnel stages for the clients you're on

- A research or angle doc whenever a new client or a new offer lands

- A short note each week covering what's working, what's dead and what you want to test next



You d
 what gets made. I sign off on it, I don't spec it for you.



### What you need



- At least two years making Meta ads with real budget behind them. Not spec work, not organic social posts

- **A working understanding of funnels**, with examples of ads you've built for different stages

- Copywriting that sells. You know why "unlock your potential" does nothing

- **Strong Canva skills across both statics and video.** Not resizing templates, actually building

- Comfortable in Ads Manager reading results at creative level

- Written English good enough to write ads for an Australian audience. It doesn't need to be flawless, but it needs an ear for how people actually talk

- Sensible use of AI (more on that below)

- **A computer running at least two screens, ideally three.** I'm being direct about this because it isn't a preference. You'll be across Ads Manager, Canva, research tabs, transcripts and ClickUp at the same time, and doing that on one monitor slows the work to a crawl. If you don't have the setup now, tell me in your application and we'll sort it out before you start

- Reliable internet, and you're reachable during AWST business hours



### How we work



We run the team on ClickUp and Hubstaff, so you need to be comfortable with both.



ClickUp is where tasks, briefs and creative sit. Everything gets tracked there, so I can see what's in progress without having to chase people for updates.



Hubstaff tracks your hours and takes periodic screenshots while you're working. I'd rather say that plainly up front than surprise you with it. It isn't about looking over your shoulder, it's how contractors get paid accurately and how I know a job is properly resourced. If that's not something you're willing to work with, this isn't the right fit and no hard feelings.



### Helpful, not essential



- Lead gen for coaching and service businesses. Health, fitness, gyms and nutrition make up a big share of our book, so experience selling to that market is a real advantage

- Google Ads

- GoHighLevel

- Pulling buyer language out of call recordings and form responses



### On AI



I want you using it. Research, competitor angles, summarising reviews and call transcripts, throwing up variations for you to react to, sorting through data. If it halves the time it takes you to get to a good ad, use it.



What I won't accept is raw AI output going out as the finished product.



The value is in what you do afterwards. Stripping out the generic phrasing, putting the buyer's real words back in, breaking up the rhythm that gives it away, adding the specific detail that only someone who did the research would know to include. Anyone can prompt. What I'm paying for is the judgement to spot when something has come back flat, and the skill to fix it.



If it reads like ChatGPT by the time it hits my inbox, it went out too early.



Tools are on us. Canva Pro, AI subscriptions, research tools, whatever the job needs. You shouldn't be paying for software out of your own pocket.



### Don't apply if



- Your application is AI written. Not because AI is banned here, but I need to hear how you think before I can work out how you'd use it. Rough English with a sharp idea beats polished English with nothing behind it, every time

- Your portfolio is logos, brand kits and Instagram grids. I need to see paid ads

- You need a full brief before you can get started



### What you get



- Long term ongoing work. I'm looking for someone who stays

- Every tool you need, paid for

- Paid on time, every time, through Wise

- A direct line to me, with no account managers in between

- Real budgets, real accounts and real data to learn from

- Room to grow into a lead creative role as the agency grows



---



## HOW TO APPLY (paste this too, it's the filter)



Should take you ten minutes. Miss a step and I won't read it.



**1. Subject line, in this format:**

`CREATIVE STRATEGIST, [Your Name], [best ad you've ever seen that you didn't make]`



**2. Three Meta ads you've made.** A link or screenshot of each, plus one line on the angle and which funnel stage it was for. Add the numbers if you have them.



**3. Write me two hooks.** Same offer, same business: an Australian gym owner selling a $5,000 coaching program to other gym owners.

- One hook for cold traffic who've never heard of him

- One hook for someone who's already had a sales call and hasn't signed

- One line on why they're different



Just the hooks. No design, no script, no document.



**4. Quick answers:**

- How do you use AI in your work, and what do you always do to it afterwards?

- How many monitors are you running, and are you fine with ClickUp and Hubstaff?



Every application that follows the steps gets read. Anyone shortlisted gets a paid trial on a live client account before we talk about anything ongoing.



---

---



# NOTES FOR MARLON (do not paste)



## 1. Sort out Denus's lane before you post



If this hire lands, Denus becomes execution only, producing from the strategist's briefs. That can work fine and it's cheaper than replacing him, but he should be told that's the structure rather than work it out on his own. Same goes for the referral you were messaging about. If she's a real strategist, send her the two hooks task before you post publicly. Ten minutes of her time, ten seconds of yours, and it might save you the whole hiring round.



## 2. On the salary



AUD $1,200 to $1,500 is roughly USD $780 to $980 at current rates, so worth checking the rate on the day. Genuine creative strategists on OnlineJobs.ph, the ones who research an offer and build the angle without a brief, generally sit around USD $1,000 to $1,600. Your range lands just under that.



You can still hire well at this number, but two things help:



Post the $1,500, not the range. People read a range as the bottom figure, and $1,200 puts you in editor and designer territory, which is the exact profile you're trying to get away from.



If you can't stretch, buy fewer hours instead of paying less per hour. Twenty hours a week at $1,200 reads as a senior part-time role and pulls a different applicant than forty hours at the same money. On that platform the rate signals seniority far more than the hours do.



Also check the currency dropdown when you post. 
 usually only offers USD or PHP. If AUD isn't there, put the USD figure in the field and state the AUD amount in the body so nobody can argue about it later.



## 3. Expect volume



You'll get well over a hundred applications and most will be templated. Sort on the subject line first, which clears out everyone who skim read. Then read nothing but the two hooks. Ignore the portfolios on the first pass, they all look the same and half are borrowed. Twenty minutes and you'll have your shortlist.



## 4. What the two hooks tell you



The whole test is in the gap between them. Cold traffic and a warm lead who's already had a sales call need completely different messages, so anyone who thinks in funnels will produce two hooks that barely resemble each other. Anyone who doesn't will hand you the same hook twice with a word swapped. That's your answer, and it takes ten seconds to see.



Second thing to look at is the language itself. The scenario is a gym owner selling to gym owners, so the hook should sound like a bloke who runs gyms. If it comes back as "unlock the growth your gym deserves," they've either used AI or they write like AI on their own, and either way it's the problem you already have.



## 5. Always run a paid trial



One live client, a fixed fee, an agreed set of creatives. Pravar or Bowie would both work as a test. Nothing in an application tells you whether someone can research an offer without you holding their hand. Only a trial on your own accounts does that.



## 6. On AI in the application



There's no AI-proof test, and chasing one will cost you good applicants. The two-hook task is deliberately short, so someone can paste it into ChatGPT in seconds. That's fine. AI writes generic hooks, and generic is exactly what you're screening out, so it fails the test on its own merits rather than needing to be caught.



If you do want to check, put the task in a Google Doc, give edit access, and look at File then Version history. Typed writing appears as hundreds of small edits, pasted AI appears as one block landing in a second. Worth the effort at shortlist stage, not before.

title: Content Marketer
description:

This is a content-first, video-first role. The majority of the work is producing video: scripting it, filming it, editing it, and appearing in it. You will be on camera regularly: talking-head explainers, short-form social video, founder-style pieces, product and service walkthroughs, and event or behind-the-scenes content. If being on camera is not something you enjoy, this is not the role for you.



Around that core, you will run Deskwork's social channels, design supporting graphics, and manage
 campaigns for the Australia and New Zealand market. The goal is brand awareness, engagement, and inbound leads.





Key Responsibilities

-Video Content & On-Camera Presence (primary focus)

-Script, film, and edit short-form video (Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn video, TikTok-style formats) on a consistent weekly cadence.

 Marketing

Working knowledge of Mailchimp or a similar

title: QA Developer (with Lovable experience)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

QA & Development Support Specialist — Vibe Coding

Platforms



About the Role

Our client builds and ships products using AI-assisted “vibe coding” platforms — currently

Lovable, with more platforms likely to follow. We're looking for a hands-on Virtual Assistant

who can go beyond surface-level testing: someone who understands what's actually

happening under the hood of these AI-generated builds, can catch bugs before users do, and

can open the code and fix it directly when something breaks.



This is not a general VA role. It's for someone who is comfortable clicking through an app AND

comfortable in a codebase — reading components, tracing a bug to its source, and shipping a

fix without needing a developer to hold their hand.



What You'll Be Doing

• Perform structured QA on apps built in Lovable (and future vibe coding platforms):

functional testing, edge cases, responsive/mobile checks, cross-browser checks.

• Reproduce bugs, document them clearly (steps, expected vs. actual, screenshots/screen

recordings), and track them to resolution.

• Open the underlying codebase, understand what the AI generated, and fix bugs directly —

front-end, back-end, or database/config level as needed.

• Review AI-generated code for quality issues before they become problems: broken logic,

security gaps, messy state management, unnecessary complexity.

• Test integrations (auth, payments, APIs, database/Supabase-style backends) end-to-end,

not just the UI layer.

• Flag when a bug is a platform limitation vs. something fixable in code, and recommend the

right approach.

• Keep a lightweight QA log/tracker per project so issues and fixes are visible to the client.

• Work across multiple concurrent projects as the client's product portfolio grows beyond

the current Lovable build.



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Hands-on experience with at least one AI/vibe coding platform (Lovable, Bolt, Replit Agent,

Cursor, v0, or similar) — either building on it or fixing what it produces.

• Solid working knowledge of the underlying stack these platforms generate: React/Next.js,

JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and typically Supabase or a similar backend-as-a-service.

• Comfortable reading someone else's (or an AI's) code, not just writing your own from

scratch.

• Strong QA instincts: methodical, detail-obsessed, thinks in edge cases rather than just

“does it load.”

• Can debug independently — reads error logs, uses browser dev tools, isolates root cause

before asking for help.

• Clear written communication in English — bug reports and status updates need to be

understandable without a call.

• Reliable availability and responsiveness; this role supports active, moving projects.



Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with Supabase, Firebase, or similar (auth, database, storage, edge functions).

• Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control and code review.

• Exposure to API integrations (Stripe, third-party SaaS APIs, webhooks).

• Background in software QA/testing methodology (test cases, regression testing, bug

tracking tools like Jira/Linear/ClickUp).

• Basic understanding of security and performance basics (input validation, avoiding

exposed keys, load times).



Tools You'll Likely Use

• Lovable (primary platform currently in use)

• Browser dev tools, and/or an IDE (VS Code) for direct code edits

• Supabase or equivalent backend dashboard

• GitHub for version history

• [Project management / bug tracking tool — to be confirmed]



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Updated CV and Introduction Video

2. Active Whatsapp Number

3. A short summary of your experience with vibe coding platforms (which ones, what you

built or fixed).

4. 1–2 examples of bugs you've diagnosed and fixed in an AI-generated or unfamiliar

codebase (links, write-ups, or before/after descriptions welcome).

5. Earliest availability to start

title: Research VA — Build a Shortlist of EU Slaughterhouses
description:
We're an established meat manufacturing company based in Poland, operating for over 30 years with over 80 employees. This is a real, registered business — not an agency or a middleman — and you'll be working directly with our team.



We need a detail-focused VA to help us build a verified directory of slaughterhouses in Europe.



The raw data you will work with is public and free (official EU TRACES directory — we'll provide you instructions on how to work with that directory). Your job: check each company on Google Maps and Google, then tell us if it's a real, decent-sized business worth calling — or a tiny backyard operation that we shouldn't bother calling.



What you'll do



Check the address provided in the official EU Traces directory on Google Maps (satellite view) and search for their website

In case the company looks promising, copy the company name and website link into our Google Sheet so that this lead can be pursued later down the line





ADD = big industrial buildings, multiple trucks, real website.

SKIP = house or small farm building, no website, no serious business.

When you are unsure if something qualifies, you can ask us for our insight anytime



You need: good written English, real attention to detail, Google Sheets, a computer and stable internet. No meat industry experience needed — we'll train you with a tailored guide and 10 example rows.



Hours & pay: 36 hrs/week, flexible schedule. $4/hour, paid weekly on WISE, we can make daily payouts at first to build trust





To apply, send:



The word BEEF at the top

2–3 sentences on any research or list-building work you've done

Answer this: A slaughterhouse has no website, but satellite view shows five large buildings and 20 trucks parked outside. ADD, SKIP, or UNSURE — and why?
